īdṛgvidhaṃ sudevaṃ taṃ sthitaṃ svapurataḥ prabhum |
dṛṣṭvā jāmātaraṃ menā jahau śokaṃ mudānvitā ||
2.3.d:
ईदृग्विधं सुदेवं तं स्थितं स्वपुरतः प्रभुम् ।
दृष्ट्वा जामातरं मेना जहौ शोकं मुदान्विता ॥

2.3.s:
praśaśaṃsa svabhāgyaṃ sā girijāṃ bhūdharaṃ kulam |
mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jaharṣa ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
2.3.d:
प्रशशंस स्वभाग्यं सा गिरिजां भूधरं कुलम् ।
मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं जहर्ष च पुनः पुनः ॥

2.3.s:
nīrājanaṃ cakārāsau praphullavadanā satī |
avalokaparā tatra menā jāmātaraṃ mudā ||
2.3.d:
नीराजनं चकारासौ प्रफुल्लवदना सती ।
अवलोकपरा तत्र मेना जामातरं मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
girijoktamanusmṛtya menā vismayamāgatā |
manasaiva hyuvācedaṃ harṣaphullānanāmbujā ||
2.3.d:
गिरिजोक्तमनुस्मृत्य मेना विस्मयमागता ।
मनसैव ह्युवाचेदं हर्षफुल्लाननाम्बुजा ॥

2.3.s:
yadvai puroktaṃ ca tayā pārvatyā mama tatra ca |
tato'dhikaṃ prapaśyāmi saundaryaṃ parameśituḥ ||
2.3.d:
यद्वै पुरोक्तं च तया पार्वत्या मम तत्र च ।
ततोऽधिकं प्रपश्यामि सौन्दर्यं परमेशितुः ॥

2.3.s:
maheśasya sulāvaṇyamanirvācyaṃ ca samprati |
evaṃ vismayamāpannā menā svagṛhamāyayau ||
2.3.d:
महेशस्य सुलावण्यमनिर्वाच्यं च सम्प्रति ।
एवं विस्मयमापन्ना मेना स्वगृहमाययौ ॥

2.3.s:
praśaśaṃsuryuvatayo dhanyā dhanyā gireḥ sutā |
durgā bhagavatītyevamūcuḥ kāścana kanyakāḥ ||
2.3.d:
प्रशशंसुर्युवतयो धन्या धन्या गिरेः सुता ।
दुर्गा भगवतीत्येवमूचुः काश्चन कन्यकाः ॥

2.3.s:
na dṛṣṭo vara ityevamasmābhirdānagocaraḥ |
dhanyā hi girijādevīmūcuḥ kāścana kanyakāḥ ||
2.3.d:
न दृष्टो वर इत्येवमस्माभिर्दानगोचरः ।
धन्या हि गिरिजादेवीमूचुः काश्चन कन्यकाः ॥

2.3.s:
jagurgandharvapravarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā śaṅkararūpaṃ ca prahṛṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ||
2.3.d:
जगुर्गन्धर्वप्रवरा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ।
दृष्ट्वा शङ्कररूपं च प्रहृष्टाः सर्वदेवताः ॥

2.3.s:
nānāprakāravādyāni vādakā madhurākṣaram |
nānāprakāraśilpena vādayāmāsurādarāt ||
2.3.d:
नानाप्रकारवाद्यानि वादका मधुराक्षरम् ।
नानाप्रकारशिल्पेन वादयामासुरादरात् ॥

2.3.s:
himācalo'pi mudito dvārācāramathākarot |
menāpi sarvanārībhirmahotsavapurassaram ||
2.3.d:
हिमाचलोऽपि मुदितो द्वाराचारमथाकरोत् ।
मेनापि सर्वनारीभिर्महोत्सवपुरस्सरम् ॥

2.3.s:
parapṛcchāṃ cakārāsau muditā svagṛhaṃ yayau |
śivo niveditaṃ sthānaṃ jagāma gaṇanirjaraiḥ ||
2.3.d:
परपृच्छां चकारासौ मुदिता स्वगृहं ययौ ।
शिवो निवेदितं स्थानं जगाम गणनिर्जरैः ॥

2.3.s:
etasminnantare durgāṃ śailāntaḥ puracārikāḥ |
bahirjagmuḥ samādāya pūjituṃ kuladevatām ||
2.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दुर्गां शैलान्तः पुरचारिकाः ।
बहिर्जग्मुः समादाय पूजितुं कुलदेवताम् ॥

2.3.s:
tatra tāṃ dadṛśurdevā nimeṣarahitā mudā |
sunīlāñjanavarṇābhāṃ svāṅgaiśca pratibhūṣitām ||
2.3.d:
तत्र तां ददृशुर्देवा निमेषरहिता मुदा ।
सुनीलाञ्जनवर्णाभां स्वाङ्गैश्च प्रतिभूषिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
trinetrādṛtanetrāṃ tāmanyavāritalocanām |
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ manoharām ||
2.3.d:
त्रिनेत्रादृतनेत्रां तामन्यवारितलोचनाम् ।
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यां सकटाक्षां मनोहराम् ॥

2.3.s:
sucārukabarībhārāṃ cārupatrakaśobhitām |
kastūrībindubhissārdhaṃ sindūrabinduśobhitām ||
2.3.d:
सुचारुकबरीभारां चारुपत्रकशोभिताम् ।
कस्तूरीबिन्दुभिस्सार्धं सिन्दूरबिन्दुशोभिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣasā suvirājitām |
ratnakeyūravalayāṃ ratnakaṅkaṇamaṇḍitām ||
2.3.d:
रत्नेन्द्रसारहारेण वक्षसा सुविराजिताम् ।
रत्नकेयूरवलयां रत्नकङ्कणमण्डिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca cārugaṇḍasthalojjvalām |
maṇiratnaprabhāmuṣṭidantarājivirājitām ||
2.3.d:
सद्रत्नकुण्डलाभ्यां च चारुगण्डस्थलोज्ज्वलाम् ।
मणिरत्नप्रभामुष्टिदन्तराजिविराजिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
madhubimbādharoṣṭhāṃ ca ratnayāvakasaṃyutām |
ratnadarpaṇahastāṃ ca krīḍāpadmavibhūṣitām ||
2.3.d:
मधुबिम्बाधरोष्ठां च रत्नयावकसंयुताम् ।
रत्नदर्पणहस्तां च क्रीडापद्मविभूषिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumenāticarcitām |
kvaṇanmañjīrapādāṃ ca raktāṅghritalarājitām ||
2.3.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमेनातिचर्चिताम् ।
क्वणन्मञ्जीरपादां च रक्ताङ्घ्रितलराजिताम् ॥

2.3.s:
praṇemuḥ śirasā devīṃ bhaktiyuktāḥ samenakām |
sarve surādayo dṛṣṭvā jagadādyāṃ jagatprasūm ||
2.3.d:
प्रणेमुः शिरसा देवीं भक्तियुक्ताः समेनकाम् ।
सर्वे सुरादयो दृष्ट्वा जगदाद्यां जगत्प्रसूम् ॥

2.3.s:
trinetro netrakoṇena tāṃ dadarśa mudānvitaḥ |
śivaḥ satyākṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā vijahau virahajvaram ||
2.3.d:
त्रिनेत्रो नेत्रकोणेन तां ददर्श मुदान्वितः ।
शिवः सत्याकृतिं दृष्ट्वा विजहौ विरहज्वरम् ॥

2.3.s:
śivaḥ sarvaṃ visasmāra śivāsaṃnyastalocanaḥ |
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo harṣādgaurīvilocanaḥ ||
2.3.d:
शिवः सर्वं विसस्मार शिवासंन्यस्तलोचनः ।
पुलकाञ्चितसर्वाङ्गो हर्षाद्गौरीविलोचनः ॥

2.3.s:
atha kālī bahiḥ puryā gatvā pūjya kulāmbikām |
viveśa bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ svapitussadvijāṅganā ||
2.3.d:
अथ काली बहिः पुर्या गत्वा पूज्य कुलाम्बिकाम् ।
विवेश भवनं रम्यं स्वपितुस्सद्विजाङ्गना ॥

2.3.s:
śaṅkaro'pi suraiḥ sārdhaṃ hariṇā brahmaṇā tathā |
himācalasamuddiṣṭaṃ svasthānamagamanmudā ||
2.3.d:
शङ्करोऽपि सुरैः सार्धं हरिणा ब्रह्मणा तथा ।
हिमाचलसमुद्दिष्टं स्वस्थानमगमन्मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
tatra sarve sukhaṃ tasthuḥ sevantaḥ śaṅkaraṃ yathā |
sammānitā girīśena nānāvidhasusampadā ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
2.3.d:
तत्र सर्वे सुखं तस्थुः सेवन्तः शङ्करं यथा ।
सम्मानिता गिरीशेन नानाविधसुसम्पदा ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
2.3.m:
Obeisance to the glorious Gaurī and Śaṅkara.

In the second Rudrasaṃhitā, the third section, Pārvatīkhaṇḍa.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tataḥ śailavaraḥ so'pi prītyā durgopavītakam |
kārayāmāsa sotsāhaṃ vedamantraiśśivasya ca ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
ततः शैलवरः सोऽपि प्रीत्या दुर्गोपवीतकम् ।
कारयामास सोत्साहं वेदमन्त्रैश्शिवस्य च ॥

2.3.s:
atha viṣṇvādayo devā munayaḥ sakutūhalam |
himācalaprārthanayā viveśāntargṛhaṃ gireḥ ||
2.3.d:
अथ विष्ण्वादयो देवा मुनयः सकुतूहलम् ।
हिमाचलप्रार्थनया विवेशान्तर्गृहं गिरेः ॥

2.3.s:
śrutyācāraṃ bhavācāraṃ vidhāya ca yathārthataḥ |
śivāmalaṅkṛtāṃ cakruḥ śivadattavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
2.3.d:
श्रुत्याचारं भवाचारं विधाय च यथार्थतः ।
शिवामलङ्कृतां चक्रुः शिवदत्तविभूषणैः ॥

2.3.s:
prathamaṃ snāpayitvā tāṃ bhūṣayitvātha sarvaśaḥ |
nīrājitā sakhībhiśca viprapatnībhireva ca ||
2.3.d:
प्रथमं स्नापयित्वा तां भूषयित्वाथ सर्वशः ।
नीराजिता सखीभिश्च विप्रपत्नीभिरेव च ॥

2.3.s:
ahatāmbarayugmena śobhitā varavarṇinī |
virarāja mahāśailaduhitā śaṅkarapriyā ||
2.3.d:
अहताम्बरयुग्मेन शोभिता वरवर्णिनी ।
विरराज महाशैलदुहिता शङ्करप्रिया ॥

2.3.s:
kañcukī paramā divyā nānāratnānvitādbhutā |
vidhṛtā ca tayā devyā vilasantyadhikaṃ mune ||
2.3.d:
कञ्चुकी परमा दिव्या नानारत्नान्विताद्भुता ।
विधृता च तया देव्या विलसन्त्यधिकं मुने ॥

2.3.s:
sā babhāra tathā hāraṃ divyaratnasamanvitam |
valayāni mahārhāṇi śuddhacāmīkarāṇi ca ||
2.3.d:
सा बभार तथा हारं दिव्यरत्नसमन्वितम् ।
वलयानि महार्हाणि शुद्धचामीकराणि च ॥

2.3.s:
sthitā tatraiva subhagā dhyāyantī manasā śivam |
śuśubhe'ti mahāśailakanyakā trijagatprasūḥ ||
2.3.d:
स्थिता तत्रैव सुभगा ध्यायन्ती मनसा शिवम् ।
शुशुभेऽति महाशैलकन्यका त्रिजगत्प्रसूः ॥

2.3.s:
tadotsavo mahānāsīdubhayatra mudāvahaḥ |
dānaṃ babhūva vividhaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo vivarṇitam ||
2.3.d:
तदोत्सवो महानासीदुभयत्र मुदावहः ।
दानं बभूव विविधं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विवर्णितम् ॥

2.3.s:
anyeṣāṃ dravyadānaṃ ca babhūva vividhaṃ mahat |
gītavādyavinodaśca tatrotsavapurassaram ||
2.3.d:
अन्येषां द्रव्यदानं च बभूव विविधं महत् ।
गीतवाद्यविनोदश्च तत्रोत्सवपुरस्सरम् ॥

2.3.s:
atha viṣṇurahaṃ dhātā śakrādyā amarāstathā |
munayaśca mahāprītyā nikhilāḥ sotsavā mudā ||
2.3.d:
अथ विष्णुरहं धाता शक्राद्या अमरास्तथा ।
मुनयश्च महाप्रीत्या निखिलाः सोत्सवा मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
supraṇamya śivāṃ bhaktyā smṛtvā śivapadāmbujam |
samprāpya himagiryājñāṃ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ samāśritāḥ ||
2.3.d:
सुप्रणम्य शिवां भक्त्या स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्बुजम् ।
सम्प्राप्य हिमगिर्याज्ञां स्वं स्वं स्थानं समाश्रिताः ॥

2.3.s:
etasminnantare tatra jyotiḥ śāstraviśāradaḥ |
himavantaṃ girīndraṃ taṃ gargo vākyamabhāṣata ||
2.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र ज्योतिः शास्त्रविशारदः ।
हिमवन्तं गिरीन्द्रं तं गर्गो वाक्यमभाषत ॥

2.3.s:
garga uvāca |
himācala dharādhīśa svāmin kālīpatiḥ prabho |
pāṇigrahārthaṃ śambhuṃ cānaya tvaṃ nijamandiram ||
2.3.d:
गर्ग उवाच ।
हिमाचल धराधीश स्वामिन् कालीपतिः प्रभो ।
पाणिग्रहार्थं शम्भुं चानय त्वं निजमन्दिरम् ॥

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
atha taṃ samayaṃ jñātvā kanyādānocitaṃ giriḥ |
niveditaṃ ca gargeṇa mumude'tīva cetasi ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
अथ तं समयं ज्ञात्वा कन्यादानोचितं गिरिः ।
निवेदितं च गर्गेण मुमुदेऽतीव चेतसि ॥

2.3.s:
mahīdharāndvijāṃścaiva parānapi mudā giriḥ |
preṣayāmāsa suprītyā śivānayanakāmyayā ||
2.3.d:
महीधरान्द्विजांश्चैव परानपि मुदा गिरिः ।
प्रेषयामास सुप्रीत्या शिवानयनकाम्यया ॥

2.3.s:
te parvatā dvijāścaiva sarvamaṅgalapāṇayaḥ |
sañjagmuḥ sotsavāḥ prītyā yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
ते पर्वता द्विजाश्चैव सर्वमङ्गलपाणयः ।
सञ्जग्मुः सोत्सवाः प्रीत्या यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ॥

2.3.s:
tadā vāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā |
mahotsāho'bhavattatra gītanṛtyānvitena hi ||
2.3.d:
तदा वादित्रघोषेण ब्रह्मघोषेण भूयसा ।
महोत्साहोऽभवत्तत्र गीतनृत्यान्वितेन हि ॥

2.3.s:
śrutvā vāditranirghoṣaṃ sarve śaṅkarasevakāḥ |
utthitāstvaikapadyena sadevarṣigaṇā mudā ||
2.3.d:
श्रुत्वा वादित्रनिर्घोषं सर्वे शङ्करसेवकाः ।
उत्थितास्त्वैकपद्येन सदेवर्षिगणा मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
parasparaṃ samūcuste harṣanirbharamānasāḥ |
atrāgacchanti girayaḥ śivānayanakāmyayā ||
2.3.d:
परस्परं समूचुस्ते हर्षनिर्भरमानसाः ।
अत्रागच्छन्ति गिरयः शिवानयनकाम्यया ॥

2.3.s:
pāṇigrahaṇakālo hi nūnaṃ sadyaḥ samāgataḥ |
mahadbhāgyaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ samprāptamiha manmahe ||
2.3.d:
पाणिग्रहणकालो हि नूनं सद्यः समागतः ।
महद्भाग्यं हि सर्वेषां सम्प्राप्तमिह मन्महे ॥

2.3.s:
dhanyā vayaṃ viśeṣeṇa vivāhaṃ śivayordhruvam |
drakṣyāmaḥ paramaprītyā jagatāṃ maṅgalālayam ||
2.3.d:
धन्या वयं विशेषेण विवाहं शिवयोर्ध्रुवम् ।
द्रक्ष्यामः परमप्रीत्या जगतां मङ्गलालयम् ॥

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
evaṃ yāvadabhūtteṣāṃ saṃvādastatra cādarāt |
tāvatsarve samāyātāḥ parvatendrasya mantriṇaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
एवं यावदभूत्तेषां संवादस्तत्र चादरात् ।
तावत्सर्वे समायाताः पर्वतेन्द्रस्य मन्त्रिणः ॥

2.3.s:
te gatvā prārthayāñcakruḥ śivaṃ viṣṇvādikānapi |
kanyādānocitaḥ kālo vartate gamyatāmiti ||
2.3.d:
ते गत्वा प्रार्थयाञ्चक्रुः शिवं विष्ण्वादिकानपि ।
कन्यादानोचितः कालो वर्तते गम्यतामिति ॥

2.3.s:
te tacchrutvā surāḥ sarve mune viṣṇvādayo'khilāḥ |
mumuduścetasātīva jayetyūcurgiriṃ drutam ||
2.3.d:
ते तच्छ्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे मुने विष्ण्वादयोऽखिलाः ।
मुमुदुश्चेतसातीव जयेत्यूचुर्गिरिं द्रुतम् ॥

2.3.s:
śivo'pi mumude'tīva kālīprāpaṇalālasaḥ |
guptaṃ cakāra taccihnaṃ manasyevādbhutākṛtiḥ ||
2.3.d:
शिवोऽपि मुमुदेऽतीव कालीप्रापणलालसः ।
गुप्तं चकार तच्चिह्नं मनस्येवाद्भुताकृतिः ॥

2.3.s:
atha snānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena maṅgaladravyasaṃyutam |
śūlinā suprasannena lokānugrahakāriṇā ||
2.3.d:
अथ स्नानं कृतं तेन मङ्गलद्रव्यसंयुतम् ।
शूलिना सुप्रसन्नेन लोकानुग्रहकारिणा ॥

2.3.s:
snātaḥ suvāsasā yuktaḥ sarvaistaiḥ parivāritaḥ |
āropito vṛṣaskandhe lokapālaiḥ susevitaḥ ||
2.3.d:
स्नातः सुवाससा युक्तः सर्वैस्तैः परिवारितः ।
आरोपितो वृषस्कन्धे लोकपालैः सुसेवितः ॥

2.3.s:
puraskṛtya prabhuṃ sarve jagmurhimagirergṛham |
vādyāni vādayantaśca kṛtavantaḥ kutūhalam ||
2.3.d:
पुरस्कृत्य प्रभुं सर्वे जग्मुर्हिमगिरेर्गृहम् ।
वाद्यानि वादयन्तश्च कृतवन्तः कुतूहलम् ॥

2.3.s:
himāgapreṣitā viprāstathā te parvatottamāḥ |
śambhoragracarā hyāsankutūhalasamanvitāḥ ||
2.3.d:
हिमागप्रेषिता विप्रास्तथा ते पर्वतोत्तमाः ।
शम्भोरग्रचरा ह्यासन्कुतूहलसमन्विताः ॥

2.3.s:
babhau chatreṇa mahatā dhriyamāṇo hi mūrdhani |
cāmarairvījyamāno'sau savitāno maheśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
बभौ छत्रेण महता ध्रियमाणो हि मूर्धनि ।
चामरैर्वीज्यमानोऽसौ सवितानो महेश्वरः ॥

2.3.s:
ahaṃ viṣṇustathā cendro lokapālāstathaiva ca |
agragāḥ smātiśobhante śriyā paramayā śritāḥ ||
2.3.d:
अहं विष्णुस्तथा चेन्द्रो लोकपालास्तथैव च ।
अग्रगाः स्मातिशोभन्ते श्रिया परमया श्रिताः ॥

2.3.s:
tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ |
punaḥ punaravādyanta vāditrāṇi mahotsave ||
2.3.d:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पटहानकगोमुखाः ।
पुनः पुनरवाद्यन्त वादित्राणि महोत्सवे ॥

2.3.s:
tathaiva gāyakāḥ sarve jaguḥ paramamaṅgalam |
nartakyo nanṛtuḥ sarvā nānātālasamanvitāḥ ||
2.3.d:
तथैव गायकाः सर्वे जगुः परममङ्गलम् ।
नर्तक्यो ननृतुः सर्वा नानातालसमन्विताः ॥

2.3.s:
ebhissameto jagadekabandhu-ryayau tadānīṃ parameśavarcasā |
susevyamānaḥ sakalaiḥ sureśvarai-rvikīryamāṇaḥ kusumaiśca harṣitaiḥ ||
2.3.d:
एभिस्समेतो जगदेकबन्धु-र्ययौ तदानीं परमेशवर्चसा ।
सुसेव्यमानः सकलैः सुरेश्वरै-र्विकीर्यमाणः कुसुमैश्च हर्षितैः ॥

2.3.s:
sampūjitastadā śambhuḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam |
saṃstūyamāno bahvībhiḥ stutibhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
सम्पूजितस्तदा शम्भुः प्रविष्टो यज्ञमण्डपम् ।
संस्तूयमानो बह्वीभिः स्तुतिभिः परमेश्वरः ॥

2.3.s:
vṛṣāduttārayāmāsurmaheśaṃ parvatottamāḥ |
ninyurgṛhāntaraṃ prītyā mahotsavapurassaram ||
2.3.d:
वृषादुत्तारयामासुर्महेशं पर्वतोत्तमाः ।
निन्युर्गृहान्तरं प्रीत्या महोत्सवपुरस्सरम् ॥
2.3.m: Delighted, Himācala then performed the welcome ceremony at the gate; / Menā too, along with all the women, performed it accompanied by great celebration.

2.3.s:
himālayo'pi samprāptaṃ sadevagaṇamīśvaram |
praṇamya vidhivadbhaktyā nīrājanamathākarot ||
2.3.d:
हिमालयोऽपि सम्प्राप्तं सदेवगणमीश्वरम् ।
प्रणम्य विधिवद्भक्त्या नीराजनमथाकरोत् ॥

2.3.s:
sarvānsurānmunīnanyān praṇamya samahotsavaḥ |
sammānamakarotteṣāṃ praśaṃsansvavidhiṃ mudā ||
2.3.d:
सर्वान्सुरान्मुनीनन्यान् प्रणम्य समहोत्सवः ।
सम्मानमकरोत्तेषां प्रशंसन्स्वविधिं मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
so'gaḥsācyutamīśānaṃ supādyārghyapurassaram |
sadevamukhyavargaṃ ca nināya svālayāntaram ||
2.3.d:
सोऽगःसाच्युतमीशानं सुपाद्यार्घ्यपुरस्सरम् ।
सदेवमुख्यवर्गं च निनाय स्वालयान्तरम् ॥

2.3.s:
prāṅgaṇe sthāpayāmāsa ratnasiṃhāsaneṣu tān |
sarvānviṣṇuṃ ca māmīśaṃ viśiṣṭāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ||
2.3.d:
प्राङ्गणे स्थापयामास रत्नसिंहासनेषु तान् ।
सर्वान्विष्णुं च मामीशं विशिष्टांश्च विशेषतः ॥

2.3.s:
sakhībhirmenayā prītyā brāhmaṇastrībhireva ca |
anyābhiśca purandhrībhiścakre nīrājanaṃ mudā ||
2.3.d:
सखीभिर्मेनया प्रीत्या ब्राह्मणस्त्रीभिरेव च ।
अन्याभिश्च पुरन्ध्रीभिश्चक्रे नीराजनं मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
purodhasā kṛtyavidā śaṅkarāya mahātmane |
madhuparkādikaṃ yadyatkṛtyaṃ tattatkṛtaṃ mudā ||
2.3.d:
पुरोधसा कृत्यविदा शङ्कराय महात्मने ।
मधुपर्कादिकं यद्यत्कृत्यं तत्तत्कृतं मुदा ॥

2.3.s:
mayā sa noditastatra purodhāḥ kṛtavāṃstadā |
sumaṅgalaṃ ca yatkarma prastāvasadṛśaṃ mune ||
2.3.d:
मया स नोदितस्तत्र पुरोधाः कृतवांस्तदा ।
सुमङ्गलं च यत्कर्म प्रस्तावसदृशं मुने ॥

2.3.s:
antarvedyāṃ mahāprītyā sampraviśya himādriṇā |
yatra sā pārvatī kanyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
2.3.d:
अन्तर्वेद्यां महाप्रीत्या सम्प्रविश्य हिमाद्रिणा ।
यत्र सा पार्वती कन्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥

2.3.s:
vedikopari tanvaṅgī saṃsthitā suvirājitā |
tatra nīto mahādevo viṣṇunā ca mayā saha ||
2.3.d:
वेदिकोपरि तन्वङ्गी संस्थिता सुविराजिता ।
तत्र नीतो महादेवो विष्णुना च मया सह ॥

2.3.s:
lagnaṃ nirīkṣamāṇāste vācaspatipurogamāḥ |
kanyādānocitaṃ tatra babhūvuḥ paramotsavāḥ ||
2.3.d:
लग्नं निरीक्षमाणास्ते वाचस्पतिपुरोगमाः ।
कन्यादानोचितं तत्र बभूवुः परमोत्सवाः ॥

2.3.s:
tatropaviṣṭo gargaśca yatrāsti ghaṭikālayam |
yāvaccheṣā ghaṭī tāvatkṛtaṃ praṇavabhāṣaṇam ||
2.3.d:
तत्रोपविष्टो गर्गश्च यत्रास्ति घटिकालयम् ।
यावच्छेषा घटी तावत्कृतं प्रणवभाषणम् ॥

2.3.s:
puṇyāhaṃ pravadan gargaḥ samādadhre'ñjaliṃ mudā |
pārvatyakṣatapūrṇaṃ ca vavṛṣe ca śivopari ||
2.3.d:
पुण्याहं प्रवदन् गर्गः समादध्रेऽञ्जलिं मुदा ।
पार्वत्यक्षतपूर्णं च ववृषे च शिवोपरि ॥

2.3.s:
tayā sampūjito rudro dadhyakṣatakuśāmbubhiḥ |
paramodārayā tatra pārvatyā rucirāsyayā ||
2.3.d:
तया सम्पूजितो रुद्रो दध्यक्षतकुशाम्बुभिः ।
परमोदारया तत्र पार्वत्या रुचिरास्यया ॥

2.3.s:
vilokayantī taṃ śambhuṃ yasyārthe paramaṃ tapaḥ |
kṛtaṃ purā mahāprītyā virarāja śivāti sā ||
2.3.d:
विलोकयन्ती तं शम्भुं यस्यार्थे परमं तपः ।
कृतं पुरा महाप्रीत्या विरराज शिवाति सा ॥

2.3.s:
mayā mune tadoktastu gargādimunibhiśca saḥ |
samānarca śivāṃ śambhuḥ laukikācārasaṃrataḥ ||
2.3.d:
मया मुने तदोक्तस्तु गर्गादिमुनिभिश्च सः ।
समानर्च शिवां शम्भुः लौकिकाचारसंरतः ॥

2.3.s:
evaṃ parasparaṃ tau vai pārvatīparameśvarau |
arcayantau tadānīṃ ca śuśubhāte jaganmayau ||
2.3.d:
एवं परस्परं तौ वै पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ ।
अर्चयन्तौ तदानीं च शुशुभाते जगन्मयौ ॥

2.3.s:
trailokyalakṣmyā saṃvītau nirīkṣantau parasparam |
tadā nīrājitau lakṣmyādibhiḥ strībhirviśeṣataḥ ||
2.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यलक्ष्म्या संवीतौ निरीक्षन्तौ परस्परम् ।
तदा नीराजितौ लक्ष्म्यादिभिः स्त्रीभिर्विशेषतः ॥

2.3.s:
tathāparā vai dvijayoṣitaśca nīrājayāmāsuratho purastriyaḥ |
śivāṃ ca śambhuñca vilokayantyo'-vāpurmudaṃ tāḥ sakalā mahotsavam ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
2.3.d:
तथापरा वै द्विजयोषितश्च नीराजयामासुरथो पुरस्त्रियः ।
शिवां च शम्भुञ्च विलोकयन्त्यो'-वापुर्मुदं ताः सकला महोत्सवम् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
2.3.m: Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, named “The Description of the Groom’s Arrival and Subsequent Events,” in the Pārvatī section, the third in the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā, of the auspicious Śivapurāṇa.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
etasminnantare tatra gargācāryapraṇoditaḥ |
himavānmenayā sārdhaṃ kanyāṃ dātuṃ pracakrame ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र गर्गाचार्यप्रणोदितः ।
हिमवान्मेनया सार्धं कन्यां दातुं प्रचक्रमे ॥
2.3.m:
In the meantime, Garga, skilled in the science of astronomy, / spoke these words there to Himavat, the lord of mountains:

Brahmā said: / In the meantime, prompted by the teacher Garga, / Himavat, along with Menā, proceeded to give away the maiden.

2.3.s:
haimaṃ kalaśamādāya menā cārdhāṅgamāśritā |
himādreśca mahābhāgā vastrābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
2.3.d:
हैमं कलशमादाय मेना चार्धाङ्गमाश्रिता ।
हिमाद्रेश्च महाभागा वस्त्राभरणभूषिता ॥
2.3.m: Taking a golden water-pot, the highly fortunate Menā, / adorned with garments and ornaments, stood at the side of the snowy mountain.

2.3.s:
pādyādibhistataḥ śailaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ svapurohitaḥ |
taṃ varaṃ varayāmāsa vastracandanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
2.3.d:
पाद्यादिभिस्ततः शैलः प्रहृष्टः स्वपुरोहितः ।
तं वरं वरयामास वस्त्रचन्दनभूषणैः ॥
2.3.m: Then, delighted, with water for washing the feet and other offerings, along with his priest, the mountain / chose that bridegroom with garments, sandalwood paste, and ornaments.

2.3.s:
tato himādriṇā proktā dvijāstithyādikīrtane |
prayogo bhaṇyatāṃ tāvadasminsamaya āgate ||
2.3.d:
ततो हिमाद्रिणा प्रोक्ता द्विजास्तिथ्यादिकीर्तने ।
प्रयोगो भण्यतां तावदस्मिन्समय आगते ॥
2.3.m: Then the twice-born were addressed by the snowy mountain regarding the proclamation of the lunar day and other details: / "Let the liturgical formula be spoken now that this proper time has arrived."

2.3.s:
tatheti coktā te sarve kālajñā dvijasattamāḥ |
tithyādikīrtanaṃ cakruḥ prītyā paramanirvṛtāḥ ||
2.3.d:
तथेति चोक्ता ते सर्वे कालज्ञा द्विजसत्तमाः ।
तिथ्यादिकीर्तनं चक्रुः प्रीत्या परमनिर्वृताः ॥
2.3.m: Saying, "So be it," all those best of the twice-born, knowers of the proper time, / proclaimed the lunar day and other details with joy, supremely pleased.

2.3.s:
tato himācalaḥ prītyā śambhunā prerito hṛdā |
sūtīkṛtapareśena vihasan śambhumabravīt ||
2.3.d:
ततो हिमाचलः प्रीत्या शम्भुना प्रेरितो हृदा ।
सूतीकृतपरेशेन विहसन् शम्भुमब्रवीत् ॥
2.3.m: Then the snowy mountain, affectionately prompted in his heart by Śambhu, / the Supreme Lord having made him an instrument, smilingly addressed Śambhu:

2.3.s:
svagotraṃ kathyatāṃ śambho pravaraśca kulaṃ tathā |
nāma vedaṃ tathā śākhāṃ mākārṣīḥ samayātyayam ||
2.3.d:
स्वगोत्रं कथ्यतां शम्भो प्रवरश्च कुलं तथा ।
नाम वेदं तथा शाखां माकार्षीः समयात्ययम् ॥
2.3.m: "Declare your lineage, O Śambhu, and also your lineage-sages and family, / your name, Veda, and Vedic branch; do not let the proper time pass."

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacastasya himādreḥ śaṅkarastadā |
sumukho vimukhaḥ sadyo'pyaśocyaḥ śocyatāṃ gataḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य हिमाद्रेः शङ्करस्तदा ।
सुमुखो विमुखः सद्योऽप्यशोच्यः शोच्यतां गतः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing that speech of the snowy mountain, Śaṅkara then, / who was cheerful-faced, immediately turned his face away, and though not to be pitied, became pitiable.

2.3.s:
evaṃvidhaḥ suravarairmunibhistadānīṃ gandharvayakṣagaṇasiddhagaṇaistathaiva |
dṛṣṭo niruttaramukho bhagavānmaheśo'-kārṣīssuhāsyamatha tatra sa nārada tvam ||
2.3.d:
एवंविधः सुरवरैर्मुनिभिस्तदानीं गन्धर्वयक्षगणसिद्धगणैस्तथैव ।
दृष्टो निरुत्तरमुखो भगवान्महेशो'-कार्षीस्सुहास्यमथ तत्र स नारद त्वम् ॥
2.3.m: When the Lord Maheśa was thus seen by the best of gods, by the sages, / and likewise by the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakṣas, and Siddhas to be at a loss for an answer, you, O Nārada, gave a gentle smile.

2.3.s:
vīṇāmavādayaṃstvaṃ hi brahmavijño'tha nārada |
śivena preritastatra manasā śambhumānasaḥ ||
2.3.d:
वीणामवादयंस्त्वं हि ब्रह्मविज्ञोऽथ नारद ।
शिवेन प्रेरितस्तत्र मनसा शम्भुमानसः ॥
2.3.m: You, O Nārada, knower of Brahman, whose mind was devoted to Śambhu, / prompted in mind by Śiva, played upon your vīṇā there.

2.3.s:
tadā nivārito dhīmān parvatendreṇa vai haṭhāt |
viṣṇunā ca mayā devairmunibhiścākhilaistathā ||
2.3.d:
तदा निवारितो धीमान् पर्वतेन्द्रेण वै हठात् ।
विष्णुना च मया देवैर्मुनिभिश्चाखिलैस्तथा ॥
2.3.m: Then you, the wise one, were forcibly restrained by the king of mountains, / and by Viṣṇu, by me, by the gods, and by all the sages.

2.3.s:
na nivṛtto'bhavastvaṃ hi sa yadā śaṅkarecchayā |
iti prokto'driṇā tarhi vīṇāṃ mā vādayādhunā ||
2.3.d:
न निवृत्तोऽभवस्त्वं हि स यदा शङ्करेच्छया ।
इति प्रोक्तोऽद्रिणा तर्हि वीणां मा वादयाधुना ॥
2.3.m: When you did not desist, because of the will of Śaṅkara, / then the mountain said to you: ‘Do not play the lute now!’

2.3.s:
suniṣiddho haṭhāttena devarṣe tvaṃ yadā budha |
pratyavoco girīśaṃ taṃ susaṃsmṛtya maheśvaram ||
2.3.d:
सुनिषिद्धो हठात्तेन देवर्षे त्वं यदा बुध ।
प्रत्यवोचो गिरीशं तं सुसंस्मृत्य महेश्वरम् ॥
2.3.m: When, O wise celestial sage, you were firmly forbidden by him by force, / you replied to that lord of the mountain, calling Maheśvara well to mind.

2.3.s:
nārada uvāca |
tvaṃ hi mūḍhatvamāpanno na jānāsi ca kiñcana |
vācye maheśaviṣaye'tīvāsi tvaṃ bahirmukhaḥ ||
2.3.d:
नारद उवाच ।
त्वं हि मूढत्वमापन्नो न जानासि च किञ्चन ।
वाच्ये महेशविषयेऽतीवासि त्वं बहिर्मुखः ॥
2.3.m: Nārada said: / ‘You have indeed fallen into delusion and know nothing at all; / regarding Maheśa, of whom you should speak, you are completely averse.

2.3.s:
tvayā pṛṣṭho haraḥ sākṣātsvagotrakathanaṃ prati |
samaye'smiṃstadatyantamupahāsakaraṃ vacaḥ ||
2.3.d:
त्वया पृष्ठो हरः साक्षात्स्वगोत्रकथनं प्रति ।
समयेऽस्मिंस्तदत्यन्तमुपहासकरं वचः ॥
2.3.m: Hara was directly asked by you to state his own lineage; / at this moment, that is an utterly ridiculous statement.

2.3.s:
asya gotraṃ kulaṃ nāma naiva jānanti parvata |
viṣṇubrahmādayo'pīha pareṣāṃ kā kathā smṛtā ||
2.3.d:
अस्य गोत्रं कुलं नाम नैव जानन्ति पर्वत ।
विष्णुब्रह्मादयोऽपीह परेषां का कथा स्मृता ॥
2.3.m: O mountain, even Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and the rest do not know his lineage, family, or name here; / what mention can there be of others?

2.3.s:
yasyaikadivase śaila brahmakoṭirlayaṃ gatā |
sa eva śaṅkarastedya dṛṣṭaḥ kālītapobalāt ||
2.3.d:
यस्यैकदिवसे शैल ब्रह्मकोटिर्लयं गता ।
स एव शङ्करस्तेद्य दृष्टः कालीतपोबलात् ॥
2.3.m: In a single day of whom, O mountain, ten million Brahmās dissolve, / that very Śaṅkara has today been seen by you through the power of Kālī’s austerity.

2.3.s:
arūpo'yaṃ parabrahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ |
nirākāro nirvikārī māyādhīśaḥ parātparaḥ ||
2.3.d:
अरूपोऽयं परब्रह्म निर्गुणः प्रकृतेः परः ।
निराकारो निर्विकारी मायाधीशः परात्परः ॥
2.3.m: He is formless, the supreme Brahman, free of qualities, beyond primordial matter; / without shape, immutable, ruler of delusion, higher than the highest.

2.3.s:
agotrakulanāmā hi svatantro bhaktavatsalaḥ |
tadicchayā hi saguṇaḥ sutanurbahunāmabhṛt ||
2.3.d:
अगोत्रकुलनामा हि स्वतन्त्रो भक्तवत्सलः ।
तदिच्छया हि सगुणः सुतनुर्बहुनामभृत् ॥
2.3.m: He has no lineage, family, or name; he is independent and affectionate toward devotees; / yet by his own will he possesses qualities, a beautiful body, and bears many names.

2.3.s:
sugotrī gotrahīnaśca kulahīnaḥ kulīnakaḥ |
pārvatītapasā so'dya jāmātā te na saṃśayaḥ ||
2.3.d:
सुगोत्री गोत्रहीनश्च कुलहीनः कुलीनकः ।
पार्वतीतपसा सोऽद्य जामाता ते न संशयः ॥
2.3.m: He has a noble lineage and is devoid of lineage; he is destitute of family and of noble birth; / through Pārvatī’s austerity, he is today your son-in-law, without doubt.

2.3.s:
līlāvihāriṇā tena mohitaṃ sacarācaram |
no jānāti śivaṃ ko'pi prājño'pi girisattama ||
2.3.d:
लीलाविहारिणा तेन मोहितं सचराचरम् ।
नो जानाति शिवं कोऽपि प्राज्ञोऽपि गिरिसत्तम ॥
2.3.m: The moving and unmoving world has been deluded by him as he disports in sport; / no one knows Śiva, O best of mountains, even if wise.

2.3.s:
liṅgākṛtermaheśasya kena dṛṣṭaṃ na mastakam |
viṣṇurgatvā hi pātālaṃ tadainaṃ nāpa vismitaḥ ||
2.3.d:
लिङ्गाकृतेर्महेशस्य केन दृष्टं न मस्तकम् ।
विष्णुर्गत्वा हि पातालं तदैनं नाप विस्मितः ॥
2.3.m: Who has ever seen the head of Maheśa in the form of the Liṅga? / Viṣṇu went to the netherworld, but astonished, did not find it then.

2.3.s:
kiṃ bahūktyā nagaśreṣṭha śivamāyā duratyayā |
tadadhīnāstrayo lokā haribrahmādayo'pi ca ||
2.3.d:
किं बहूक्त्या नगश्रेष्ठ शिवमाया दुरत्यया ।
तदधीनास्त्रयो लोका हरिब्रह्मादयोऽपि च ॥
2.3.m: What need of many words, O best of mountains? The delusion of Śiva is hard to overcome; / dependent upon it are the three worlds, and even Hari, Brahmā, and the rest.

2.3.s:
tasmāttvayā śivātāta suvicārya prayatnataḥ |
na kartavyo vimarśo'tra tvevaṃvidhavare manāk ||
2.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया शिवातात सुविचार्य प्रयत्नतः ।
न कर्तव्यो विमर्शोऽत्र त्वेवंविधवरे मनाक् ॥
2.3.m: Therefore, O father of Śivā, having reflected well with effort, / you must not entertain even the slightest doubt regarding such a bridegroom.’

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā tvaṃ mune jñānī śivecchākāryakārakaḥ |
pratyavocaḥ punastaṃ vai śailedraṃ harṣayan girā ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्युक्त्वा त्वं मुने ज्ञानी शिवेच्छाकार्यकारकः ।
प्रत्यवोचः पुनस्तं वै शैलेद्रं हर्षयन् गिरा ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, O wise sage, performing the deed willed by Śiva, / you again addressed that lord of mountains, delighting him with your words.

2.3.s:
nārada uvāca |
śṛṇu tāta mahāśaila śivājanaka madvacaḥ |
tacchrutvā tanayāṃ devīṃ dehi tvaṃ śaṅkarāya hi ||
2.3.d:
नारद उवाच ।
शृणु तात महाशैल शिवाजनक मद्वचः ।
तच्छ्रुत्वा तनयां देवीं देहि त्वं शङ्कराय हि ॥
2.3.m: Nārada said: / ‘Listen, dear father, O great mountain, progenitor of Śivā, to my word; / having heard it, give your divine daughter indeed to Śaṅkara.

2.3.s:
saguṇasya maheśasya līlayā rūpadhāriṇaḥ |
gotraṃ kulaṃ vijānīhi nādameva hi kevalam ||
2.3.d:
सगुणस्य महेशस्य लीलया रूपधारिणः ।
गोत्रं कुलं विजानीहि नादमेव हि केवलम् ॥
2.3.m: Of Maheśa, who possesses qualities and assumed a form in sport, / know the lineage and family to be nothing other than Sound alone.

2.3.s:
śivo nādamayaḥ satyaṃ nādaḥ śivamayastathā |
ubhayorantaraṃ nāsti nādasya ca śivasya ca ||
2.3.d:
शिवो नादमयः सत्यं नादः शिवमयस्तथा ।
उभयोरन्तरं नास्ति नादस्य च शिवस्य च ॥
2.3.m: Śiva is truly made of Sound, and Sound is made of Śiva; / there is no difference between the two, Sound and Śiva.

2.3.s:
sṛṣṭau prathamajatvāddhi līlāsaguṇarūpiṇaḥ |
śivānnādasya śailendra sarvotkṛṣṭastataḥ sa hi ||
2.3.d:
सृष्टौ प्रथमजत्वाद्धि लीलासगुणरूपिणः ।
शिवान्नादस्य शैलेन्द्र सर्वोत्कृष्टस्ततः स हि ॥
2.3.m: Because in creation it was born first from Śiva, who assumed a form endowed with qualities in sport, / therefore, O lord of mountains, Sound is the most excellent of all.

2.3.s:
ato hi vāditā vīṇā preritena mayādya vai |
sarveśvareṇa manasā śaṅkareṇa himālaya ||
2.3.d:
अतो हि वादिता वीणा प्रेरितेन मयाद्य वै ।
सर्वेश्वरेण मनसा शङ्करेण हिमालय ॥
2.3.m: Therefore indeed, O Himālaya, the lute was played by me today, / impelled inwardly by Śaṅkara, the lord of all.’

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
etacchrutvā tava mune vacastattu giriśvaraḥ |
himādristoṣamāpanno gatavismayamānasaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तव मुने वचस्तत्तु गिरिश्वरः ।
हिमाद्रिस्तोषमापन्नो गतविस्मयमानसः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having heard that speech of yours, O sage, the lord of mountains, / the Himālaya, attained satisfaction, his mind freed from bewilderment.

2.3.s:
atha viṣṇuprabhṛtayaḥ surāśca munayastathā |
sādhu sādhviti te sarve procurvigatavismayāḥ ||
2.3.d:
अथ विष्णुप्रभृतयः सुराश्च मुनयस्तथा ।
साधु साध्विति ते सर्वे प्रोचुर्विगतविस्मयाः ॥
2.3.m: Then Viṣṇu and the other gods, and likewise the sages, / their bewilderment gone, all said, ‘Well done! Well done!’

2.3.s:
maheśvarasya gāmbhīryaṃ jñātvā sarve vicakṣaṇāḥ |
savismayā mahāmodānvitāḥ procuḥ parasparam ||
2.3.d:
महेश्वरस्य गाम्भीर्यं ज्ञात्वा सर्वे विचक्षणाः ।
सविस्मया महामोदान्विताः प्रोचुः परस्परम् ॥
2.3.m: Having understood the profundity of Maheśvara, all the wise ones, / filled with wonder and great joy, spoke to one another:

2.3.s:
yasyājñayā jagadidaṃ ca viśālameva jātaṃ parātparataro nijabodharūpaḥ |
śarvaḥ svatantragatikṛtparabhāvagamyaḥ so'sau trilokapatiradya ca naḥ sudṛṣṭaḥ ||
2.3.d:
यस्याज्ञया जगदिदं च विशालमेव जातं परात्परतरो निजबोधरूपः ।
शर्वः स्वतन्त्रगतिकृत्परभावगम्यः सोऽसौ त्रिलोकपतिरद्य च नः सुदृष्टः ॥
2.3.m: ‘By whose command this vast universe came into being, who is higher than the highest, the very embodiment of his own consciousness, / Śarva, who acts of his own independent will, accessible through supreme devotion—that lord of the three worlds has today been well beheld by us.’

2.3.s:
atha te parvataśreṣṭhā mervādyā jātasambhramāḥ |
ūcuste caikapadyena himavantaṃ nageśvaram ||
2.3.d:
अथ ते पर्वतश्रेष्ठा मेर्वाद्या जातसम्भ्रमाः ।
ऊचुस्ते चैकपद्येन हिमवन्तं नगेश्वरम् ॥
2.3.m: Then those best of mountains, Meru and the rest, filled with excitement, / spoke in one voice to Himavat, the lord of mountains.

2.3.s:
parvatā ūcuḥ |
kanyādāne sthīyatāṃ cādya śaila-nāthoktyā kiṃ kāryanāśastavaiva |
satyaṃ brūmo nātra kāryo vimarśaḥ tasmātkanyā dīyatāmīśvarāya ||
2.3.d:
पर्वता ऊचुः ।
कन्यादाने स्थीयतां चाद्य शैल-नाथोक्त्या किं कार्यनाशस्तवैव ।
सत्यं ब्रूमो नात्र कार्यो विमर्शः तस्मात्कन्या दीयतामीश्वराय ॥
2.3.m: The mountains said: / ‘Abide now by the giving of your daughter, O lord of mountains; what is the use of words that ruin your own undertaking? / We speak the truth: no doubt should be entertained here; therefore let the maiden be given to the Lord.’

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ suhṛdāṃ sa himālayaḥ |
svakanyādānamakarocchivāya vidhinoditaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां सुहृदां स हिमालयः ।
स्वकन्यादानमकरोच्छिवाय विधिनोदितः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having heard the words of those friends, that Himālaya, / prompted according to the rite, performed the giving of his maiden to Śiva.

2.3.s:
imāṃ kanyāṃ tubhyamahaṃ dadāmi parameśvara |
bhāryārthaṃ parigṛhṇīṣva prasīda sakaleśvara ||
2.3.d:
इमां कन्यां तुभ्यमहं ददामि परमेश्वर ।
भार्यार्थं परिगृह्णीष्व प्रसीद सकलेश्वर ॥
2.3.m: ‘This maiden I give to you, O Parameśvara; / accept her as your wife; be gracious, O Lord of all!’

2.3.s:
tasmai rudrāya mahate mantreṇānena dattavān |
himācalo nijāṃ kanyāṃ pārvatīṃ trijagatprasūm ||
2.3.d:
तस्मै रुद्राय महते मन्त्रेणानेन दत्तवान् ।
हिमाचलो निजां कन्यां पार्वतीं त्रिजगत्प्रसूम् ॥
2.3.m: To that great Rudra, with this mantra, / the Himālaya gave his daughter Pārvatī, mother of the three worlds.

2.3.s:
itthaṃ śivākaraṃ śailaṃ śivahaste nidhāya ca |
mumodātīva manasi tīrṇakāmamahārṇavaḥ ||
2.3.d:
इत्थं शिवाकरं शैलं शिवहस्ते निधाय च ।
मुमोदातीव मनसि तीर्णकाममहार्णवः ॥
2.3.m: Having thus placed Śivā’s hand into Śiva’s hand, the mountain / rejoiced exceedingly in his heart, having crossed the great ocean of his desire.

2.3.s:
vedamantreṇa giriśo girijākarapaṅkajam |
jagrāha svakareṇāśu prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
वेदमन्त्रेण गिरिशो गिरिजाकरपङ्कजम् ।
जग्राह स्वकरेणाशु प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः ॥
2.3.m: With a Vedic mantra, Giriśa, the lotus hand of the daughter of the mountain / quickly took with his own hand, pleased, Parameśvara.

2.3.s:
kṣitiṃ saṃspṛśya kāmasya ko'dāditi manuṃ mune |
papāṭha śaṅkaraḥ prītyā darśayam̐llaukikīṃ gatim ||
2.3.d:
क्षितिं संस्पृश्य कामस्य कोऽदादिति मनुं मुने ।
पपाठ शङ्करः प्रीत्या दर्शयम्̐ल्लौकिकीं गतिम् ॥
2.3.m: Touching the earth, Śaṅkara recited with love the mantra of Kāma, ‘Who gave [this]?’, / showing worldly conduct, O sage.

2.3.s:
mahotsavo mahānāsītsarvatra pramudāvahaḥ |
babhūva jayasaṃrāvo divi bhūmyantarikṣake ||
2.3.d:
महोत्सवो महानासीत्सर्वत्र प्रमुदावहः ।
बभूव जयसंरावो दिवि भूम्यन्तरिक्षके ॥
2.3.m: There was a great festival everywhere bringing joy; / shouts of victory arose in heaven, on earth, and in the mid-air.

2.3.s:
sādhuśabdaṃ namaḥ śabdaṃ cakruḥ sarve'tiharṣitāḥ |
gandharvāḥ sujaguḥ prītyā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ||
2.3.d:
साधुशब्दं नमः शब्दं चक्रुः सर्वेऽतिहर्षिताः ।
गन्धर्वाः सुजगुः प्रीत्या ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ॥
2.3.m: Extremely delighted, all uttered cries of ‘Well done!’ and ‘Homage!’; / the gandharvas sang sweetly with love, and the troops of apsarases danced.

2.3.s:
himācalasya paurā hi mumuduścāti cetasi |
maṅgalaṃ mahadāsīdvai mahotsavapurassaram ||
2.3.d:
हिमाचलस्य पौरा हि मुमुदुश्चाति चेतसि ।
मङ्गलं महदासीद्वै महोत्सवपुरस्सरम् ॥
2.3.m: The citizens of the Himālaya rejoiced greatly in their hearts; / there was indeed great auspiciousness accompanied by a grand festival.

2.3.s:
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca śakraśca nirjarā munayo'khilāḥ |
harṣitā hyabhavaṃścāti praphullavadanāmbujāḥ ||
2.3.d:
अहं विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च निर्जरा मुनयोऽखिलाः ।
हर्षिता ह्यभवंश्चाति प्रफुल्लवदनाम्बुजाः ॥
2.3.m: I, Viṣṇu, Śakra, the gods, and all the sages / became exceedingly joyful, with lotus faces fully blossomed.

2.3.s:
atha śailavaraḥ so'dātsuprasanno himācalaḥ |
śivāya kanyādānasya sāṅgatāṃ suyathocitām ||
2.3.d:
अथ शैलवरः सोऽदात्सुप्रसन्नो हिमाचलः ।
शिवाय कन्यादानस्य साङ्गतां सुयथोचिताम् ॥
2.3.m: Then that best of mountains, the Himālaya, well pleased, gave / to Śiva the completion of the giving of the daughter in a manner most suitable.

2.3.s:
tato bandhujanāstasya śivāṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ |
daduḥ śivāya saddravyaṃ nānāvidhividhānataḥ ||
2.3.d:
ततो बन्धुजनास्तस्य शिवां सम्पूज्य भक्तितः ।
ददुः शिवाय सद्द्रव्यं नानाविधिविधानतः ॥
2.3.m: Then his kinsmen, having worshipped Śivā with devotion, / gave good wealth to Śiva according to various procedures.

2.3.s:
himālayastuṣṭamanāḥ pārvatīśivaprītaye |
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi dadau tatra munīśvara ||
2.3.d:
हिमालयस्तुष्टमनाः पार्वतीशिवप्रीतये ।
नानाविधानि द्रव्याणि ददौ तत्र मुनीश्वर ॥
2.3.m: With a satisfied mind, for the pleasure of Pārvatī and Śiva, / the Himālaya gave various kinds of goods there, O lord of sages.

2.3.s:
yautukāni dadau tasmai ratnāni vividhāni ca |
cāruratnavikārāṇi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ||
2.3.d:
यौतुकानि ददौ तस्मै रत्नानि विविधानि च ।
चारुरत्नविकाराणि पात्राणि विविधानि च ॥
2.3.m: He gave him dowry gifts and diverse jewels, / and various vessels made of beautiful jewels,

2.3.s:
gavāṃ lakṣaṃ hayānāṃ ca sajjitānāṃ śataṃ tathā |
dāsīnāmanuraktānāṃ lakṣaṃ saddravyabhūṣitam ||
2.3.d:
गवां लक्षं हयानां च सज्जितानां शतं तथा ।
दासीनामनुरक्तानां लक्षं सद्द्रव्यभूषितम् ॥
2.3.m: a hundred thousand cows, a hundred harnessed horses, / a hundred thousand devoted female servants adorned with fine ornaments,

2.3.s:
nāgānāṃ śatalakṣaṃ hi rathānāṃ ca tathā mune |
suvarṇajaṭitānāṃ ca ratnasāravinirmitam ||
2.3.d:
नागानां शतलक्षं हि रथानां च तथा मुने ।
सुवर्णजटितानां च रत्नसारविनिर्मितम् ॥
2.3.m: ten million elephants, and likewise, O sage, of chariots / studded with gold and fashioned from the finest gems.

2.3.s:
itthaṃ himālayo dattvā svasutāṃ girijāṃ śivām |
śivāya parameśāya vidhināpa kṛtārthatām ||
2.3.d:
इत्थं हिमालयो दत्त्वा स्वसुतां गिरिजां शिवाम् ।
शिवाय परमेशाय विधिनाप कृतार्थताम् ॥
2.3.m: Having thus given his daughter the mountain-born Śivā / to Śiva, to the supreme Lord, according to rite, the Himālaya attained the fulfillment of his purpose.

2.3.s:
atha śailavaro mādhyandinoktastotrato mudā |
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ sadgirā sukṛtāñjaliḥ ||
2.3.d:
अथ शैलवरो माध्यन्दिनोक्तस्तोत्रतो मुदा ।
तुष्टाव परमेशानं सद्गिरा सुकृताञ्जलिः ॥
2.3.m: Then the best of mountains, with a hymn proclaimed by the Mādhyandinas, joyfully / praised Parameśāna with excellent words, his hands reverently folded.

2.3.s:
tato vedavidā tenājñaptā munigaṇāstadā |
śiro'bhiṣekaṃ cakruste śivāyāḥ paramotsavāḥ ||
2.3.d:
ततो वेदविदा तेनाज्ञप्ता मुनिगणास्तदा ।
शिरोऽभिषेकं चक्रुस्ते शिवायाः परमोत्सवाः ॥
2.3.m: Then, instructed by him who was conversant with the Veda, the hosts of sages, / experiencing supreme celebration, performed the head-consecration of Śivā.

2.3.s:
devābhidhānamuccārya paryukṣaṇavidhiṃ vyadhuḥ |
mahotsavastadā cāsīnmahānandakaro mune ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
2.3.d:
देवाभिधानमुच्चार्य पर्युक्षणविधिं व्यधुः ।
महोत्सवस्तदा चासीन्महानन्दकरो मुने ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
2.3.m:
Uttering the names of the gods, they performed the rite of sprinkling; / there was a great festival then, bringing immense bliss, O sage.

Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Giving of the Maiden’, in the Pārvatī section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā in the glorious Śivapurāṇa.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
atho mamājñayā vipraiḥ saṃsthāpyānalamīśvaraḥ |
homaṃ cakāra tatraivamaṅke saṃsthāpya pārvatīm ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
अथो ममाज्ञया विप्रैः संस्थाप्यानलमीश्वरः ।
होमं चकार तत्रैवमङ्के संस्थाप्य पार्वतीम् ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Then, at my command, the fire having been established by the brahmins, Īśvara performed the homa right there, seating Pārvatī on his lap.

2.3.s:
ṛgyajussāmamantraiścāhutiṃ vahnau dadau śivaḥ |
lājāñjaliṃ dadau kālībhrātā mainākasaṃjñakaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ऋग्यजुस्साममन्त्रैश्चाहुतिं वह्नौ ददौ शिवः ।
लाजाञ्जलिं ददौ कालीभ्राता मैनाकसंज्ञकः ॥
2.3.m: Śiva offered oblations into the fire with the mantras of the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma Vedas. Kālī’s brother, named Maināka, offered the handful of roasted grain.

2.3.s:
atha kālī śivaścobhau cakraturvidhivanmudā |
vahnipradakṣiṇāṃ tāta lokācāraṃ vidhāya ca ||
2.3.d:
अथ काली शिवश्चोभौ चक्रतुर्विधिवन्मुदा ।
वह्निप्रदक्षिणां तात लोकाचारं विधाय च ॥
2.3.m: Then Kālī and Śiva both joyfully circumambulated the fire according to the rule, dear one, and observed worldly custom.

2.3.s:
tatrādbhutamalañcakre caritaṃ girijāpatiḥ |
tadeva śṛṇu devarṣe tavasnehād bravīmyaham ||
2.3.d:
तत्राद्भुतमलञ्चक्रे चरितं गिरिजापतिः ।
तदेव शृणु देवर्षे तवस्नेहाद् ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
2.3.m: There the lord of the mountain's daughter performed a wondrous deed. Hear just that, O divine sage; out of affection for you I tell it.

2.3.s:
tasminnavasare cāhaṃ śivamāyāvimohitaḥ |
apaśyaṃ caraṇe devyā nakhenduṃ ca manoharam ||
2.3.d:
तस्मिन्नवसरे चाहं शिवमायाविमोहितः ।
अपश्यं चरणे देव्या नखेन्दुं च मनोहरम् ॥
2.3.m: On that occasion, deluded by the māyā of Śiva, I saw the charming moon of the nail on the goddess's foot.

2.3.s:
darśanāttasya ca tadābhūvaṃ devamune hyaham |
madanena samāviṣṭo'tīva kṣubhitamānasaḥ ||
2.3.d:
दर्शनात्तस्य च तदाभूवं देवमुने ह्यहम् ।
मदनेन समाविष्टोऽतीव क्षुभितमानसः ॥
2.3.m: From seeing that, O divine sage, I then became overcome with passion, my mind exceedingly agitated.

2.3.s:
muhurmuhurapaśyaṃ vai tadaṅgaṃ smaramohitaḥ |
tatastaddarśanātsadyo vīryaṃ me prācyutadbhuvi ||
2.3.d:
मुहुर्मुहुरपश्यं वै तदङ्गं स्मरमोहितः ।
ततस्तद्दर्शनात्सद्यो वीर्यं मे प्राच्युतद्भुवि ॥
2.3.m: Again and again, infatuated by the god of love, I looked at her limb. Then, from that gazing, my semen instantly fell to the ground.

2.3.s:
retasā kṣaratā tena lajjito'haṃ pitāmahaḥ |
mune vyamardaṃ tacchinnaṃ caraṇābhyāṃ hi gopayan ||
2.3.d:
रेतसा क्षरता तेन लज्जितोऽहं पितामहः ।
मुने व्यमर्दं तच्छिन्नं चरणाभ्यां हि गोपयन् ॥
2.3.m: As that semen was dripping, I, the grandfather, was ashamed. Concealing it, O sage, I ground what had fallen with my two feet.

2.3.s:
tajjñātvā ca mahādevaścukopātīva nārada |
hantumaicchattadā śīghraṃ māṃ vidhiṃ kāmamohitam ||
2.3.d:
तज्ज्ञात्वा च महादेवश्चुकोपातीव नारद ।
हन्तुमैच्छत्तदा शीघ्रं मां विधिं काममोहितम् ॥
2.3.m: Having learned that, Mahādeva grew exceedingly furious, O Nārada; he then wished immediately to slay me, Brahmā, who was deluded by lust.

2.3.s:
hāhākāro mahānāsīttatra sarvatra nārada |
janāścakampire sarve bhayamāyāti viśvabhṛt ||
2.3.d:
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तत्र सर्वत्र नारद ।
जनाश्चकम्पिरे सर्वे भयमायाति विश्वभृत् ॥
2.3.m: A great cry of dismay arose everywhere there, O Nārada; all the people trembled, and fear came upon the sustainer of the universe.

2.3.s:
tatastaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ śambhuṃ viṣṇvādyā nirjarā mune |
sakopamprajvalantaṃ ca tejasā hantumudyatam ||
2.3.d:
ततस्तं तुष्टुवुः शम्भुं विष्ण्वाद्या निर्जरा मुने ।
सकोपम्प्रज्वलन्तं च तेजसा हन्तुमुद्यतम् ॥
2.3.m: Then the gods, Viṣṇu and the rest, praised Śambhu, O sage, who was blazing with rage, radiant with splendor, and intent on killing [me].

2.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ |
devadeva jagadvyāpin parameśa sadāśiva |
jagadīśa jagannātha samprasīda jaganmaya ||
2.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
देवदेव जगद्व्यापिन् परमेश सदाशिव ।
जगदीश जगन्नाथ सम्प्रसीद जगन्मय ॥
2.3.m: The gods said: / O God of gods, all-pervading one, Parameśa, Sadāśiva, Lord of the universe, Master of the universe, be gracious, O you who are made of the universe!

2.3.s:
sarveṣāmapi bhāvānāṃ tvamātmā heturīśvaraḥ |
nirvikāro'vyayo nityo nirvikalpo'kṣaraḥ paraḥ ||
ādyantāvasya yanmadhyamidamanyadahaṃ bahiḥ |
yato'vyayaḥ sa naitāni tatsatyambrahma cidbhavān | 14 ||
2.3.d:
सर्वेषामपि भावानां त्वमात्मा हेतुरीश्वरः ।
निर्विकारोऽव्ययो नित्यो निर्विकल्पोऽक्षरः परः ॥
आद्यन्तावस्य यन्मध्यमिदमन्यदहं बहिः ।
यतोऽव्ययः स नैतानि तत्सत्यम्ब्रह्म चिद्भवान् । 14 ॥
2.3.m:
You are the soul, the cause, and the lord of all beings; changeless, imperishable, eternal, free of mental construction, undecaying, the Supreme.

The beginning and end of this [universe], its middle, this [object], another, the 'I', and the outside—because you are imperishable, you are none of these; you are the true, conscious Brahman.

2.3.s:
tavaiva caraṇāmbhojaṃ muktikāmā dṛḍhavratāḥ |
visṛjyobhayataḥ saṅgaṃ munayaḥ samupāsate ||
2.3.d:
तवैव चरणाम्भोजं मुक्तिकामा दृढव्रताः ।
विसृज्योभयतः सङ्गं मुनयः समुपासते ॥
2.3.m: Desiring liberation, firm in vows, abandoning attachment on both sides, the sages worship your lotus feet alone.

2.3.s:
tvaṃ brahma pūrṇamamṛtaṃ viśokaṃ nirguṇamparam |
ānandamātramavyagramavikāramanātmakam ||
2.3.d:
त्वं ब्रह्म पूर्णममृतं विशोकं निर्गुणम्परम् ।
आनन्दमात्रमव्यग्रमविकारमनात्मकम् ॥
2.3.m: You are the full Brahman, immortal, free of sorrow, devoid of qualities, transcendent, sheer bliss, unagitated, immutable, not consisting of a soul.

2.3.s:
viśvasya heturudayasthitisaṃyamanasya hi |
tadapekṣatayātmeśo'napekṣaḥ sarvadā vibhuḥ ||
2.3.d:
विश्वस्य हेतुरुदयस्थितिसंयमनस्य हि ।
तदपेक्षतयात्मेशोऽनपेक्षः सर्वदा विभुः ॥
2.3.m: You are indeed the cause of the universe's origin, sustenance, and destruction; in relation to that you are the Lord of self, yet ever self-sufficient and omnipresent.

2.3.s:
ekastvameva sadasad dvayamadvayameva ca |
svarṇaṃ kṛtākṛtamiva vastubhedo na caiva hi ||
2.3.d:
एकस्त्वमेव सदसद् द्वयमद्वयमेव च ।
स्वर्णं कृताकृतमिव वस्तुभेदो न चैव हि ॥
2.3.m: You alone are the one, the real and the unreal, the duality and the non-duality, like gold worked or unworked, for there is no division in reality.

2.3.s:
ajñānatastvayi janairvikalpo vidito yataḥ |
tasmād bhramapratīkāro nirupādherna hi svataḥ ||
2.3.d:
अज्ञानतस्त्वयि जनैर्विकल्पो विदितो यतः ।
तस्माद् भ्रमप्रतीकारो निरुपाधेर्न हि स्वतः ॥
2.3.m: Since conceptual differentiation is known in you by people through ignorance, therefore removal of illusion cannot belong inherently to one who is without conditioning attributes.

2.3.s:
dhanyā vayaṃ maheśāna tava darśanamātrataḥ |
dṛḍhabhaktajanānandapradaḥ śambho dayāṃ kuru ||
2.3.d:
धन्या वयं महेशान तव दर्शनमात्रतः ।
दृढभक्तजनानन्दप्रदः शम्भो दयां कुरु ॥
2.3.m: Blessed are we, O Maheśāna, merely by the sight of you! O giver of bliss to firmly devoted people, O Śambhu, have mercy!

2.3.s:
tvamādistvamanādiśca prakṛtestvaṃ paraḥ pumān |
viśveśvaro jagannātho nirvikāraḥ parātparaḥ ||
2.3.d:
त्वमादिस्त्वमनादिश्च प्रकृतेस्त्वं परः पुमान् ।
विश्वेश्वरो जगन्नाथो निर्विकारः परात्परः ॥
2.3.m: You are the beginning, and you are beginningless; you are the Person beyond Prakṛti; the Lord of the universe, Master of the universe, changeless, higher than the high.

2.3.s:
yo'yaṃ brahmāsti rajasā viśvamūrtiḥ pitāmahaḥ |
tvatprasādātprabho viṣṇuḥ sattvena puruṣottamaḥ ||
2.3.d:
योऽयं ब्रह्मास्ति रजसा विश्वमूर्तिः पितामहः ।
त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रभो विष्णुः सत्त्वेन पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
2.3.m: This Brahmā who exists through rajas, the cosmic-formed Grandfather, and by your grace, O Lord, Viṣṇu, through sattva, the Supreme Person,

2.3.s:
kālāgnirudrastamasā paramātmā guṇaiḥ paraḥ |
sadā śivo maheśānaḥsarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
कालाग्निरुद्रस्तमसा परमात्मा गुणैः परः ।
सदा शिवो महेशानःसर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः ॥
2.3.m: and Kālāgnirudra through tamas—you are the Supreme Soul beyond the qualities, Sadāśiva, Maheśāna, the all-pervading Maheśvara.

2.3.s:
vyaktaṃ mahacca bhūtādistanmātrāṇīndriyāṇi ca |
tvayaivādhiṣṭhitānyeva viśvamūrte maheśvara ||
mahādeva pareśāna karuṇākara śaṅkara |
prasīda devadeveśa prasīda puruṣottama | 25 ||
2.3.d:
व्यक्तं महच्च भूतादिस्तन्मात्राणीन्द्रियाणि च ।
त्वयैवाधिष्ठितान्येव विश्वमूर्ते महेश्वर ॥
महादेव परेशान करुणाकर शङ्कर ।
प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद पुरुषोत्तम । 25 ॥
2.3.m:
The manifest, the great principle, the gross elements, the subtle elements, and the senses are all presided over by you alone, O cosmic-formed Maheśvara!

O Mahādeva, Pareśāna, source of compassion, Śaṅkara! Be pleased, O God of the lord of gods, be pleased, O Supreme Person!

2.3.s:
vāsāṃsi sāgarāḥ sapta diśaścaiva mahābhujāḥ |
dyaurmūrdhā te vibhornābhiḥ khaṃ vāyurnāsikā tataḥ ||
2.3.d:
वासांसि सागराः सप्त दिशश्चैव महाभुजाः ।
द्यौर्मूर्धा ते विभोर्नाभिः खं वायुर्नासिका ततः ॥
2.3.m: The seven oceans are your garments, and the directions are your mighty arms; the sky is your head, O all-pervading one; your navel is space, and the wind is your breath.

2.3.s:
cakṣūṃṣyagnī ravissomaḥ keśā meghāstava prabho |
nakṣatratārakādyāśca grahāścaiva vibhūṣaṇam ||
2.3.d:
चक्षूंष्यग्नी रविस्सोमः केशा मेघास्तव प्रभो ।
नक्षत्रतारकाद्याश्च ग्रहाश्चैव विभूषणम् ॥
2.3.m: Fire, the sun, and the moon are your eyes; the clouds are your hair, O Lord; the constellations, stars, and planets are your ornaments.

2.3.s:
kathaṃ stoṣyāmi deveśa tvāṃ vibho parameśvara |
vācāmagocaro'si tvaṃ manasā cāpi śaṅkara ||
2.3.d:
कथं स्तोष्यामि देवेश त्वां विभो परमेश्वर ।
वाचामगोचरोऽसि त्वं मनसा चापि शङ्कर ॥
2.3.m: How shall I praise you, O God of gods, O all-pervading Parameśvara? You are beyond the reach of words and mind, O Śaṅkara!

2.3.s:
pañcāsyāya ca rudrāya pañcāśatkoṭimūrtaye |
tryadhipāya variṣṭhāya vidyātattvāya te namaḥ ||
2.3.d:
पञ्चास्याय च रुद्राय पञ्चाशत्कोटिमूर्तये ।
त्र्यधिपाय वरिष्ठाय विद्यातत्त्वाय ते नमः ॥
2.3.m: To the five-faced Rudra, whose forms are fifty crores, the ruler of the three [worlds], the most excellent, the reality of wisdom: homage to you!

2.3.s:
anirdeśyāya nityāya vidyujjvālāya rūpiṇe |
agnivarṇāya devāya śaṅkarāya namo namaḥ ||
2.3.d:
अनिर्देश्याय नित्याय विद्युज्ज्वालाय रूपिणे ।
अग्निवर्णाय देवाय शङ्कराय नमो नमः ॥
2.3.m: To the indescribable, the eternal, the one having the form of a flash of lightning, the god of fire's hue, Śaṅkara: homage, homage!

2.3.s:
vidyutkoṭipratīkāśamaṣṭakoṇaṃ suśobhanam |
rūpamāsthāya loke'smin saṃsthitāya namo namaḥ ||
2.3.d:
विद्युत्कोटिप्रतीकाशमष्टकोणं सुशोभनम् ।
रूपमास्थाय लोकेऽस्मिन् संस्थिताय नमो नमः ॥
2.3.m: To him who, having assumed an eight-cornered, very radiant form resembling ten million lightnings, abides in this world: homage, homage!

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
brahmaṇe me dadau śīghramabhayaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तेषां प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः ।
ब्रह्मणे मे ददौ शीघ्रमभयं भक्तवत्सलः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having heard their words, Parameśvara was pleased; affectionate toward devotees, he quickly granted safety to me, Brahmā.

2.3.s:
atha sarve surāstatra viṣṇvādyā munayastathā |
abhavansusmitāstāta cakruśca paramotsavam ||
2.3.d:
अथ सर्वे सुरास्तत्र विष्ण्वाद्या मुनयस्तथा ।
अभवन्सुस्मितास्तात चक्रुश्च परमोत्सवम् ॥
2.3.m: Then all the gods there, Viṣṇu and the others, and the sages as well, became smiling, dear one, and celebrated a great festival.

2.3.s:
mama tadretasā tāta marditena muhurmuhuḥ |
abhavankaṇakāstatra bhūriśaḥ paramojjvalāḥ ||
2.3.d:
मम तद्रेतसा तात मर्दितेन मुहुर्मुहुः ।
अभवन्कणकास्तत्र भूरिशः परमोज्ज्वलाः ॥
2.3.m: From that semen of mine, dear one, which had been crushed again and again, there arose particles in great numbers, exceedingly brilliant.

2.3.s:
ṛṣayo bahavo jātā bālakhilyāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
kaṇakaistaiśca vīryasya prajvaladbhiḥ svatejasā ||
2.3.d:
ऋषयो बहवो जाता बालखिल्याः सहस्रशः ।
कणकैस्तैश्च वीर्यस्य प्रज्वलद्भिः स्वतेजसा ॥
2.3.m: From those particles of semen, blazing with their own brilliance, many sages were born—the Bālakhilyas in their thousands.

2.3.s:
atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve upatasthustadā mune |
mamāntikaṃ paraprītyā tāta tāteti cābruvan ||
2.3.d:
अथ ते ऋषयः सर्वे उपतस्थुस्तदा मुने ।
ममान्तिकं परप्रीत्या तात तातेति चाब्रुवन् ॥
2.3.m: Then all those sages, O sage, approached my presence with great love and said, 'Father, father!'

2.3.s:
īśvarecchāprayuktena proktāste nāradena hi |
bālakhilyāstu te tatra kopayuktena cetasā ||
2.3.d:
ईश्वरेच्छाप्रयुक्तेन प्रोक्तास्ते नारदेन हि ।
बालखिल्यास्तु ते तत्र कोपयुक्तेन चेतसा ॥
2.3.m: Prompted by the will of Īśvara, Nārada with an angry heart spoke to those Bālakhilyas there:

2.3.s:
nārada uvāca |
gacchadhvaṃ saṅgatā yūyaṃ parvataṃ gandhamādanam |
na sthātavyaṃ bhavadbhiśca na hi vo'tra prayojanam ||
2.3.d:
नारद उवाच ।
गच्छध्वं सङ्गता यूयं पर्वतं गन्धमादनम् ।
न स्थातव्यं भवद्भिश्च न हि वोऽत्र प्रयोजनम् ॥
2.3.m: Nārada said: / 'Assemble and go to Mount Gandhamādana; you must not stay here, nor is there any purpose for you here.

2.3.s:
tatra taptvā tapaścāti bhavitāro munīśvarāḥ |
sūryaśiṣyāḥ śivasyaivājñayā me kathitaṃ tvidam ||
2.3.d:
तत्र तप्त्वा तपश्चाति भवितारो मुनीश्वराः ।
सूर्यशिष्याः शिवस्यैवाज्ञया मे कथितं त्विदम् ॥
2.3.m: Having performed great austerity there, you will become supreme sages, disciples of the Sun. This has been spoken by me by the command of Śiva alone.'

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityuktāste tadā sarve bālakhilyāśca parvatam |
satvaraṃ prayayurnatvā śaṅkaraṃ gandhamādanam ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्युक्तास्ते तदा सर्वे बालखिल्याश्च पर्वतम् ।
सत्वरं प्रययुर्नत्वा शङ्करं गन्धमादनम् ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having been addressed thus, all those Bālakhilyas then bowed to Śaṅkara and swiftly departed for Mount Gandhamādana.

2.3.s:
viṣṇvādibhistadābhūvaṃ śvāsito'haṃ munīśvara |
nirbhayaḥ parameśānapreritaistairmahātmabhiḥ ||
2.3.d:
विष्ण्वादिभिस्तदाभूवं श्वासितोऽहं मुनीश्वर ।
निर्भयः परमेशानप्रेरितैस्तैर्महात्मभिः ॥
2.3.m: Then, O supreme sage, I was consoled by Viṣṇu and the others, and, urged by those great-souled ones, I became free from fear of Parameśāna.

2.3.s:
astavaṃ cāpi sarveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam |
sarvakāryakaraṃ jñātvā duṣṭagarvāpahārakam ||
2.3.d:
अस्तवं चापि सर्वेशं शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् ।
सर्वकार्यकरं ज्ञात्वा दुष्टगर्वापहारकम् ॥
2.3.m: And I praised the lord of all, Śaṅkara, affectionate toward devotees, knowing him as the accomplisher of every purpose, the destroyer of wicked pride:

2.3.s:
devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho |
tvameva kartā sarvasya bhartā hartā ca sarvathā ||
2.3.d:
देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो ।
त्वमेव कर्ता सर्वस्य भर्ता हर्ता च सर्वथा ॥
2.3.m: 'O God of gods, Mahādeva, ocean of compassion, O Lord! You alone are the creator of all, the sustainer, and the destroyer in every way.

2.3.s:
tvadicchayā hi sakalaṃ sthitaṃ hi sacarācaram |
tantyāṃ yathā balīvardā mayā jñātaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
2.3.d:
त्वदिच्छया हि सकलं स्थितं हि सचराचरम् ।
तन्त्यां यथा बलीवर्दा मया ज्ञातं विशेषतः ॥
2.3.m: For by your will all this, moving and unmoving, is held fast, like oxen on a tether; this has been especially understood by me.'

2.3.s:
ityevamuktvā so'haṃ vai praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtāñjaliḥ |
anye'pi tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve viṣṇvādyāstaṃ maheśvaram ||
2.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सोऽहं वै प्रणामं च कृताञ्जलिः ।
अन्येऽपि तुष्टुवुः सर्वे विष्ण्वाद्यास्तं महेश्वरम् ॥
2.3.m: Having spoken thus, I indeed bowed with folded hands, and all the others too, Viṣṇu and the rest, praised Maheśvara.

2.3.s:
athākarṇya nutiṃ śuddhāṃ mama dīnatayā tadā |
viṣṇvādīnāñca sarveṣāṃ prasanno'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
अथाकर्ण्य नुतिं शुद्धां मम दीनतया तदा ।
विष्ण्वादीनाञ्च सर्वेषां प्रसन्नोऽभून्महेश्वरः ॥
2.3.m: Then, having heard the pure praise offered with my humility and by all those beginning with Viṣṇu, Maheśvara was pleased.

2.3.s:
dadau so'tivaraṃ mahyamabhayaṃ prītamānasaḥ |
sarve sukhamatīvāpuratyāmodamahaṃ mune ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
2.3.d:
ददौ सोऽतिवरं मह्यमभयं प्रीतमानसः ।
सर्वे सुखमतीवापुरत्यामोदमहं मुने ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
2.3.m:
With a delighted mind he granted me the supreme boon of fearlessness; everyone experienced great happiness, and I, O sage, experienced supreme joy.

Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, entitled 'The Description of Brahmā's Delusion', in the third section, the Pārvatġkhaᅇጁa, of the second book, the Rudrasaፃhitā, in the glorious Śivamahāpurāᅇa.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tataścāhaṃ munigaṇaiḥ śeṣakṛtyaṃ śivājñayā |
akārṣaṃ nārada prītyā śivāśivavivāhataḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
ततश्चाहं मुनिगणैः शेषकृत्यं शिवाज्ञया ।
अकार्षं नारद प्रीत्या शिवाशिवविवाहतः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Then, at Śiva's command, together with the hosts of sages, / I lovingly performed the remaining rites of the wedding of Śivā and Śiva, O Nārada.

2.3.s:
tayoḥ śiro'bhiṣekaśca babhūvādaratastataḥ |
dhruvasya darśanaṃ viprāḥ kārayāmāsurādarāta ||
2.3.d:
तयोः शिरोऽभिषेकश्च बभूवादरतस्ततः ।
ध्रुवस्य दर्शनं विप्राः कारयामासुरादरात ॥
2.3.m: Then, their head-consecration was performed with reverence. / With reverence, the brahmins had [them] gaze upon Dhruva.

2.3.s:
hṛdayālambhanaṃ karma babhūva tadanantaram |
svastipāṭhaśca viprendra mahotsavapurassaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
हृदयालम्भनं कर्म बभूव तदनन्तरम् ।
स्वस्तिपाठश्च विप्रेन्द्र महोत्सवपुरस्सरः ॥
2.3.m: Next came the rite of touching the heart, / and the recitation of auspicious blessings preceded by a great celebration, O best of brahmins.

2.3.s:
śivāśirasi sindūraṃ dadau śambhurdvijājñayā |
tadānīṃ girijābhikhyādbhutāvarṇyā babhūva ha ||
2.3.d:
शिवाशिरसि सिन्दूरं ददौ शम्भुर्द्विजाज्ञया ।
तदानीं गिरिजाभिख्याद्भुतावर्ण्या बभूव ह ॥
2.3.m: At the instruction of the twice-born, Śambhu applied vermilion to Śivā's head; / at that time, Girijā's beauty became wondrous beyond description.

2.3.s:
tato viprājñayā tau dvāvekāsanasamāsthitau |
lebhāte paramāṃ śobhāṃ bhaktacittamudāvahām ||
2.3.d:
ततो विप्राज्ञया तौ द्वावेकासनसमास्थितौ ।
लेभाते परमां शोभां भक्तचित्तमुदावहाम् ॥
2.3.m: Then, at the instruction of the twice-born, the two seated together on a single seat / attained supreme splendour that brought joy to the hearts of devotees.

2.3.s:
tataḥ svasthānamāgatya saṃsravaprāśanaṃ mudā |
cakratustau nideśānme'dbhutalīlākarau mune ||
2.3.d:
ततः स्वस्थानमागत्य संस्रवप्राशनं मुदा ।
चक्रतुस्तौ निदेशान्मेऽद्भुतलीलाकरौ मुने ॥
2.3.m: Then, having returned to their own place, at my direction the two / gladly performed the partaking of the clarified butter residue, performing wondrous pastimes, O sage.

2.3.s:
itthaṃ nivṛtte vidhivadyajñe vaivāhike śivaḥ |
brahmaṇe pūrṇapātraṃ me dadau lokakṛte prabhuḥ ||
2.3.d:
इत्थं निवृत्ते विधिवद्यज्ञे वैवाहिके शिवः ।
ब्रह्मणे पूर्णपात्रं मे ददौ लोककृते प्रभुः ॥
2.3.m: When the wedding sacrifice had thus been concluded according to rule, Śiva, / the Lord and creator of the world, gave me, Brahmā, the full vessel [of gifts].

2.3.s:
godānaṃ vidhivacchambhurācāryāya dadau tataḥ |
mahādānāni ca prītyā yāni maṅgaladāni vai ||
2.3.d:
गोदानं विधिवच्छम्भुराचार्याय ददौ ततः ।
महादानानि च प्रीत्या यानि मङ्गलदानि वै ॥
2.3.m: Then Śambhu duly gave the gift of a cow to the preceptor, / and gladly gave the great gifts that bestow auspiciousness.

2.3.s:
tataḥ śatasuvarṇaṃ ca viprebhyaḥ sa dadau pṛthak |
bahubhyo ratnakoṭīśca nānādravyāṇyanekaśaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ततः शतसुवर्णं च विप्रेभ्यः स ददौ पृथक् ।
बहुभ्यो रत्नकोटीश्च नानाद्रव्याण्यनेकशः ॥
2.3.m: Then he separately gave a hundred pieces of gold to the brahmins, / and tens of millions of jewels and diverse articles in abundance to many.

2.3.s:
tadānīmamarāḥ sarve pare jīvāścarācarāḥ |
mumuduścetasātīva babhūvāti jayadhvaniḥ ||
2.3.d:
तदानीममराः सर्वे परे जीवाश्चराचराः ।
मुमुदुश्चेतसातीव बभूवाति जयध्वनिः ॥
2.3.m: Then all the immortals and other living beings, moving and unmoving, / rejoiced exceedingly in their hearts, and a great shout of victory arose.

2.3.s:
maṅgaladhvanigānaṃ ca babhūva bahu sarvataḥ |
vādyadhvanirabhūdramyo sarvānandapravardhanaḥ ||
2.3.d:
मङ्गलध्वनिगानं च बभूव बहु सर्वतः ।
वाद्यध्वनिरभूद्रम्यो सर्वानन्दप्रवर्धनः ॥
2.3.m: Auspicious sounds and songs arose abundantly on all sides; / the sound of musical instruments was delightful, increasing the joy of all.

2.3.s:
harirmayātha devāśca munayaścāpare'khilāḥ |
girimāmantrya suprītyā svasthānaṃ prayayurdrutam ||
2.3.d:
हरिर्मयाथ देवाश्च मुनयश्चापरेऽखिलाः ।
गिरिमामन्त्र्य सुप्रीत्या स्वस्थानं प्रययुर्द्रुतम् ॥
2.3.m: Then Hari, I, the gods, and all the other sages / bid farewell to the mountain with great affection and swiftly departed for our own abodes.

2.3.s:
tadānīṃ śailanagare striyaśca muditā varam |
śivāśivau samānīya yayuḥ kuhavarālayam ||
2.3.d:
तदानीं शैलनगरे स्त्रियश्च मुदिता वरम् ।
शिवाशिवौ समानीय ययुः कुहवरालयम् ॥
2.3.m: Then the women in the city of the mountain were delighted; / escorting the excellent Śivā and Śiva, they proceeded to the bridal chamber.

2.3.s:
laukikācāramājahrustāḥ striyastatra cādṛtāḥ |
mahotsāho babhūvātha sarvataḥ pramudāvahaḥ ||
2.3.d:
लौकिकाचारमाजह्रुस्ताः स्त्रियस्तत्र चादृताः ।
महोत्साहो बभूवाथ सर्वतः प्रमुदावहः ॥
2.3.m: Those women respectfully performed the customary rites there; / a great festivity then arose, bringing delight everywhere.

2.3.s:
atha tāstau samānīya dampatī janaśaṅkarau |
vāsālayaṃ mahādivyaṃ bhavācāraṃ vyadhurmudā ||
2.3.d:
अथ तास्तौ समानीय दम्पती जनशङ्करौ ।
वासालयं महादिव्यं भवाचारं व्यधुर्मुदा ॥
2.3.m: Then, leading the couple who bring welfare to all people, / they gladly performed worldly customs in the magnificent, celestial bedchamber.

2.3.s:
atho samīpamāgatya śailendranagarastriyaḥ |
nirvṛtya maṅgalaṃ karma prāpayandampatī gṛham ||
2.3.d:
अथो समीपमागत्य शैलेन्द्रनगरस्त्रियः ।
निर्वृत्य मङ्गलं कर्म प्रापयन्दम्पती गृहम् ॥
2.3.m: Then the women of the king of mountains' city came near, / completed the auspicious rites, and brought the couple into the bedchamber.

2.3.s:
kṛtvā jayadhvaniṃ cakrurgranthinirmocanādikam |
sasmitāssakaṭākṣāśca pulakāñcitavigrahāḥ ||
2.3.d:
कृत्वा जयध्वनिं चक्रुर्ग्रन्थिनिर्मोचनादिकम् ।
सस्मितास्सकटाक्षाश्च पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहाः ॥
2.3.m: Raising a shout of victory, smiling, casting side-glances, / their bodies thrilled with horripilation, they untied the nuptial knot and performed other rites.

2.3.s:
vāsagehaṃ sampraviśya mumuhuḥ kāminīvarāḥ |
praśaṃsantyaḥ svabhāgyāni paśyantyaḥ parameśvaram ||
2.3.d:
वासगेहं सम्प्रविश्य मुमुहुः कामिनीवराः ।
प्रशंसन्त्यः स्वभाग्यानि पश्यन्त्यः परमेश्वरम् ॥
2.3.m: Entering the bedchamber, the splendid women were enchanted; / beholding Parameśvara, they praised their own good fortune.

2.3.s:
mahāsurūpaveṣaṃ ca sarvalāvaṇyasaṃyutam |
navīnayauvanasthaṃ ca kāmanīcittamohanam ||
2.3.d:
महासुरूपवेषं च सर्वलावण्यसंयुतम् ।
नवीनयौवनस्थं च कामनीचित्तमोहनम् ॥
2.3.m: He had a supremely handsome form and attire, possessed of all charm, / abiding in fresh youth, enchanting the minds of lovely women,

2.3.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ susundaram |
susūkṣmavāso bibhrāṇaṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitam ||
2.3.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं सकटाक्षं सुसुन्दरम् ।
सुसूक्ष्मवासो बिभ्राणं नानारत्नविभूषितम् ॥
2.3.m: his pleasant face bearing a gentle smile, casting side-glances, exceedingly handsome, / wearing very fine garments, and adorned with diverse jewels.

2.3.s:
tadānīṃ divyanāryaśca ṣoḍaśāraṃ samāyayuḥ |
tau dampatī ca sandraṣṭuṃ mahādarapurassaram ||
2.3.d:
तदानीं दिव्यनार्यश्च षोडशारं समाययुः ।
तौ दम्पती च सन्द्रष्टुं महादरपुरस्सरम् ॥
2.3.m: Then celestial women came in sixteen groups / with great reverence to behold that couple:

2.3.s:
sarasvatī ca lakṣmīśca sāvitrī jāhnavī tathā |
aditiśca śacī caiva lopāmudrāpyarundhatī ||
2.3.d:
सरस्वती च लक्ष्मीश्च सावित्री जाह्नवी तथा ।
अदितिश्च शची चैव लोपामुद्राप्यरुन्धती ॥
2.3.m: Sarasvatī, Lakṣmī, Sāvitrī, and Jāhnavī; / Aditi, Śacī, Lopāmudrā, and Arundhatī;

2.3.s:
ahalyā tulasī svāhā rohiṇī ca vasundharā |
śatarūpā ca saṃjñā ca ratiretāḥ surastriyaḥ ||
2.3.d:
अहल्या तुलसी स्वाहा रोहिणी च वसुन्धरा ।
शतरूपा च संज्ञा च रतिरेताः सुरस्त्रियः ॥
2.3.m: Ahalyā, Tulasī, Svāhā, Rohiṇī, Vasundharā, / Śatarūpā, Saṃjñā, and Rati—these wives of the gods,

2.3.s:
devakanyā nāgakanyā munikanyā manoharāḥ |
tatra yā yāḥ sthitāstāsāṃ saṅkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ||
2.3.d:
देवकन्या नागकन्या मुनिकन्या मनोहराः ।
तत्र या याः स्थितास्तासां सङ्ख्यां कर्तुं च कः क्षमः ॥
2.3.m: as well as delightful daughters of gods, daughters of serpents, and daughters of sages. / Who could be able to number all of those who were present there?

2.3.s:
tābhī ratnāsane datte tatrovāsa śivo mudā |
tamūcuḥ kramato devyaḥ suhāsaṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ ||
2.3.d:
ताभी रत्नासने दत्ते तत्रोवास शिवो मुदा ।
तमूचुः क्रमतो देव्यः सुहासं मधुरं वचः ॥
2.3.m: When a jewelled seat was offered by them, Śiva gladly sat upon it; / one by one, the goddesses addressed sweet words to him with charming smiles.

2.3.s:
sarasvatyuvāca |
prāptā satī mahādevādhunā prāṇādhikā mudā |
dṛṣṭvā priyāsyaṃ candrābhaṃ santāpaṃ tyaja kāmuka ||
2.3.d:
सरस्वत्युवाच ।
प्राप्ता सती महादेवाधुना प्राणाधिका मुदा ।
दृष्ट्वा प्रियास्यं चन्द्राभं सन्तापं त्यज कामुक ॥
2.3.m: Sarasvatī said: / Satī, dearer to you than life itself, has now been gladly attained, O Mahādeva! / Beholding the moon-like face of your beloved, cast aside your distress, O passionate one!

2.3.s:
kālaṃ gamaya kāleśa satīsaṃśleṣapūrvakam |
viśleṣaste na bhavitā sarvakālaṃ samāśritā ||
2.3.d:
कालं गमय कालेश सतीसंश्लेषपूर्वकम् ।
विश्लेषस्ते न भविता सर्वकालं समाश्रिता ॥
2.3.m: Spend your time, O Lord of time, embracing Satī; / there will be no separation for you, for she has sought refuge in you for all time.

2.3.s:
lakṣmīruvāca |
lajjāṃ vihāya deveśa satīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi |
tiṣṭha tāṃ prati kā lajjā prāṇā yānti yayā vinā ||
2.3.d:
लक्ष्मीरुवाच ।
लज्जां विहाय देवेश सतीं कृत्वा स्ववक्षसि ।
तिष्ठ तां प्रति का लज्जा प्राणा यान्ति यया विना ॥
2.3.m: Lakṣmī said: / Setting aside shame, O Lord of the gods, embrace Satī to your chest / and remain [so]; what shame can there be toward her without whom your life-breaths depart?

2.3.s:
sāvitryuvāca |
bhojayitvā satīṃ śambho śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva mā khidaḥ |
tadācamya sakarpūraṃ tāmbūlaṃ dehi sādaram ||
2.3.d:
सावित्र्युवाच ।
भोजयित्वा सतीं शम्भो शीघ्रं त्वं भुङ्क्ष्व मा खिदः ।
तदाचम्य सकर्पूरं ताम्बूलं देहि सादरम् ॥
2.3.m: Sāvitrī said: / Having fed Satī, O Śambhu, eat quickly yourself and do not grieve; / having then rinsed your mouth, offer betel leaf with camphor respectfully [to her].

2.3.s:
jāhnavyuvāca |
svarṇakāntikarāṃ dhṛtvā keśānmārjaya yoṣitaḥ |
kāminyāḥ svāmisaubhāgyasukhaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ bhavet ||
2.3.d:
जाह्नव्युवाच ।
स्वर्णकान्तिकरां धृत्वा केशान्मार्जय योषितः ।
कामिन्याः स्वामिसौभाग्यसुखं नातः परं भवेत् ॥
2.3.m: Jāhnavī said: / Holding her hands that possess the lustre of gold, dress your woman's hair; / for a passionate woman, there can be no happiness greater than the marital fortune granted by her husband.

2.3.s:
aditiruvāca |
bhojanānte śive śambhuṃ mukhaśuddhyarthamādarāt |
jalaṃ dehi mahāprītyā dampatiprema durlabham ||
2.3.d:
अदितिरुवाच ।
भोजनान्ते शिवे शम्भुं मुखशुद्ध्यर्थमादरात् ।
जलं देहि महाप्रीत्या दम्पतिप्रेम दुर्लभम् ॥
2.3.m: Aditi said: / O Śiva, after the meal, respectfully give water to Śambhu / for cleansing the mouth with great love; the love of husband and wife is hard to attain.

2.3.s:
śacyuvāca |
kṛtvā vilāpaṃ yaddhetoḥ śivāṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi |
yo babhrāmāniśaṃ mohāt kā lajjā te priyāṃ prati ||
2.3.d:
शच्युवाच ।
कृत्वा विलापं यद्धेतोः शिवां कृत्वा च वक्षसि ।
यो बभ्रामानिशं मोहात् का लज्जा ते प्रियां प्रति ॥
2.3.m: Śacī said: / For whose sake you lamented, and holding Śivā to your chest / wandered incessantly out of infatuation—what shame can you have toward your beloved?

2.3.s:
lopāmudrovāca |
vyavahāro'sti ca strīṇāṃ bhuktvā vāsagṛhe śiva |
dattvā śivāyai tāmbūlaṃ śayanaṃ kartumarhasi ||
2.3.d:
लोपामुद्रोवाच ।
व्यवहारोऽस्ति च स्त्रीणां भुक्त्वा वासगृहे शिव ।
दत्त्वा शिवायै ताम्बूलं शयनं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
2.3.m: Lopāmudrā said: / It is the custom of women, O Śiva: having dined in the bedchamber, / and having given betel leaf to Śivā, you ought to take rest.

2.3.s:
arundhatyuvāca |
mayā dattāṃ satīmmenāṃ tubhyaṃ dātumanīpsitā |
vividhaṃ bodhayitvemāṃ suratiṃ kartumarhasi ||
2.3.d:
अरुन्धत्युवाच ।
मया दत्तां सतीम्मेनां तुभ्यं दातुमनीप्सिता ।
विविधं बोधयित्वेमां सुरतिं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
2.3.m: Arundhatī said: / Menā was unwilling to give Satī to you, [yet] she has been given by me; / having reassured her in various ways, you ought to make delightful love.

2.3.s:
ahalyovāca |
vṛddhāvasthāṃ parityajya hyatīva taruṇo bhava |
yena menānumanyeta tvāṃ sutārpitamānasā ||
2.3.d:
अहल्योवाच ।
वृद्धावस्थां परित्यज्य ह्यतीव तरुणो भव ।
येन मेनानुमन्येत त्वां सुतार्पितमानसा ॥
2.3.m: Ahalyā said: / Cast aside the state of old age and become exceedingly youthful, / so that Menā, whose mind is devoted to her daughter, may look favorably upon you.

2.3.s:
tulasyuvāca |
satī tvayā parityaktā kāmo dagdhaḥ purā kṛtaḥ |
kathaṃ tadā vasiṣṭhaśca prabho prasthāpito'dhunā ||
2.3.d:
तुलस्युवाच ।
सती त्वया परित्यक्ता कामो दग्धः पुरा कृतः ।
कथं तदा वसिष्ठश्च प्रभो प्रस्थापितोऽधुना ॥
2.3.m: Tulasī said: / Formerly Satī was abandoned by you and Kāma was burnt to ashes; / why then, O Lord, has Vasiṣṭha been sent now?

2.3.s:
svāhovāca |
sthiro bhava mahādeva strīṇāṃ vacasi sāmpratam |
vivāhe vyavahāro'sti purandhrīṇāṃ pragalbhatā ||
2.3.d:
स्वाहोवाच ।
स्थिरो भव महादेव स्त्रीणां वचसि साम्प्रतम् ।
विवाहे व्यवहारोऽस्ति पुरन्ध्रीणां प्रगल्भता ॥
2.3.m: Svāhā said: / Remain steady, O Mahādeva, at the words of women now; / in a wedding, it is the custom for married women to be outspoken.

2.3.s:
rohiṇyuvāca |
kāmaṃ pūraya pārvatyāḥ kāmaśāstraviśārada |
kuru pāraṃ svayaṃ kāmī kāminīkāmasāgaram ||
2.3.d:
रोहिण्युवाच ।
कामं पूरय पार्वत्याः कामशास्त्रविशारद ।
कुरु पारं स्वयं कामी कामिनीकामसागरम् ॥
2.3.m: Rohiṇī said: / Fulfill Pārvatī's desire, O master of the science of love; / yourself an impassioned lover, cross over the passionate woman's ocean of desire.

2.3.s:
vasundharovāca |
jānāsi bhāvaṃ bhāvajña kāmārtānāṃ ca yoṣitām |
na ca svaṃ svāminaṃ śambho īśvaraṃ pāti santatam ||
2.3.d:
वसुन्धरोवाच ।
जानासि भावं भावज्ञ कामार्तानां च योषिताम् ।
न च स्वं स्वामिनं शम्भो ईश्वरं पाति सन्ततम् ॥
2.3.m: Vasundharā said: / O knower of sentiments, you know the sentiment of women afflicted by desire; / does not a woman always protect her own husband and master, O Śambhu?

2.3.s:
śatarūpovāca |
bhogaṃ divyaṃ vinā bhuktvā na hi tuṣyetkṣudhāturaḥ |
yena tuṣṭirbhavecchambho tatkartumucitaṃ striyāḥ ||
2.3.d:
शतरूपोवाच ।
भोगं दिव्यं विना भुक्त्वा न हि तुष्येत्क्षुधातुरः ।
येन तुष्टिर्भवेच्छम्भो तत्कर्तुमुचितं स्त्रियाः ॥
2.3.m: Śatarūpā said: / Without partaking of celestial enjoyment, one afflicted by hunger is never satisfied; / whatever brings satisfaction to a woman, O Śambhu, that is proper to do.

2.3.s:
saṃjñovāca |
tūrṇaṃ prasthāpaya prītyā pārvatyā saha śaṅkaram |
ratnapradīpaṃ tāmbūlaṃ talpaṃ nirmāya nirjane ||
2.3.d:
संज्ञोवाच ।
तूर्णं प्रस्थापय प्रीत्या पार्वत्या सह शङ्करम् ।
रत्नप्रदीपं ताम्बूलं तल्पं निर्माय निर्जने ॥
2.3.m: Saṃjñā said: / With affection, quickly escort Śaṅkara together with Pārvatī, / having arranged a jewelled lamp, betel leaf, and a couch in solitude.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
strīṇāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tā uvāca śivaḥ svayam |
nirvikāraśca bhagavānyogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
स्त्रीणां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ता उवाच शिवः स्वयम् ।
निर्विकारश्च भगवान्योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of the women, Śiva himself spoke to them— / the Lord, free from passion, the guru of the gurus of the lords of yoga.

2.3.s:
śaṅkara uvāca |
devyo na brūta vacanamevambhūtaṃ mamāntikam |
jagatāṃ mātaraḥ sādhvyaḥ putre capalatā katham ||
2.3.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ।
देव्यो न ब्रूत वचनमेवम्भूतं ममान्तिकम् ।
जगतां मातरः साध्व्यः पुत्रे चपलता कथम् ॥
2.3.m: Śaṅkara said: / O goddesses, do not speak such words in my presence; / you are the mothers of the worlds, chaste women—whence this flippancy toward a son?

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā lajjitāḥ surayoṣitaḥ |
babhūvuḥ sambhramāttūṣṇīṃ citraputtalikā yathā ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
शङ्करस्य वचः श्रुत्वा लज्जिताः सुरयोषितः ।
बभूवुः सम्भ्रमात्तूष्णीं चित्रपुत्तलिका यथा ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing Śaṅkara's words, the celestial women felt ashamed; / out of bewildered awe, they fell silent like painted statues.

2.3.s:
bhuktvā miṣṭānnamācamya maheśo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje bhāryayā saha ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ pārvatīkhaṇḍe
2.3.d:
भुक्त्वा मिष्टान्नमाचम्य महेशो हृष्टमानसः ।
सकर्पूरं च ताम्बूलं बुभुजे भार्यया सह ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां तृतीयः पार्वतीखण्डे
2.3.m:
Having eaten the sweet food and sipped water, Maheśa, delighted in mind, / enjoyed betel with camphor along with his wife.

Thus ends the fiftieth chapter, entitled 'The Description of Jesting,' in the third section, the Pārvatīkhaṇḍa, of the second book, the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tasminnavasare jñātvānukūlaṃ samayaṃ ratiḥ |
suprasannā ca taṃ prāha śaṅkaraṃ dīnavatsalam ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
तस्मिन्नवसरे ज्ञात्वानुकूलं समयं रतिः ।
सुप्रसन्ना च तं प्राह शङ्करं दीनवत्सलम् ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / On that occasion, recognizing a favorable time, Rati, / well pleased, spoke to Śaṅkara, who is kind to the wretched:

2.3.s:
ratiruvāca |
gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ prāptaṃ saubhāgyamatidurlabham |
kimarthaṃ prāṇanātho me nissvārthaṃ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ||
2.3.d:
रतिरुवाच ।
गृहीत्वा पार्वतीं प्राप्तं सौभाग्यमतिदुर्लभम् ।
किमर्थं प्राणनाथो मे निस्स्वार्थं भस्मसात्कृतः ॥
2.3.m: Rati said: / Having taken Pārvatī, exceedingly rare good fortune has been obtained [by you]. / For what purpose was the lord of my life burnt to ashes without selfish motive?

2.3.s:
jīvayātra patiṃ me hi kāmavyāpāramātmani |
kuru dūraṃ ca santāpaṃ samaviśleṣahetukam ||
2.3.d:
जीवयात्र पतिं मे हि कामव्यापारमात्मनि ।
कुरु दूरं च सन्तापं समविश्लेषहेतुकम् ॥
2.3.m: Revive my husband here indeed, who inspires the work of desire in yourself! / And remove the anguish caused by our equal separation!

2.3.s:
vivāhotsava etasmin sukhino nikhilā janāḥ |
ahamekā maheśāna duḥkhinī svapatiṃ vinā ||
2.3.d:
विवाहोत्सव एतस्मिन् सुखिनो निखिला जनाः ।
अहमेका महेशान दुःखिनी स्वपतिं विना ॥
2.3.m: In this wedding festival, all the people are happy; / I alone, O Maheśāna, am sorrowful without my husband.

2.3.s:
sanāthāṃ kuru māṃ deva prasanno bhava śaṅkara |
svoktaṃ satyaṃ vidhehi tvaṃ dīnabandho para prabho ||
2.3.d:
सनाथां कुरु मां देव प्रसन्नो भव शङ्कर ।
स्वोक्तं सत्यं विधेहि त्वं दीनबन्धो पर प्रभो ॥
2.3.m: Provide me with a protector, O god! Be gracious, O Śaṅkara! / Make true your own word, O friend of the wretched, supreme lord!

2.3.s:
tvāṃ vinā kaḥ samartho'tra trailokye sacarācare |
nāśane mama duḥkhasya jñātveti karuṇāṃ kuru ||
2.3.d:
त्वां विना कः समर्थोऽत्र त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ।
नाशने मम दुःखस्य ज्ञात्वेति करुणां कुरु ॥
2.3.m: Apart from you, who here in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings is capable / of destroying my sorrow? Knowing this, show compassion!

2.3.s:
sotsave svavivāhe'sminsarvānandapradāyinī |
sotsavāmapi māṃ nātha kuru dīnakṛpākara ||
2.3.d:
सोत्सवे स्वविवाहेऽस्मिन्सर्वानन्दप्रदायिनी ।
सोत्सवामपि मां नाथ कुरु दीनकृपाकर ॥
2.3.m: In your own joyous wedding, O giver of all joy, / make me too full of joy, O lord, O bestower of grace upon the wretched!

2.3.s:
jīvite mama nāthe hi pārvatyā priyayā saha |
suvihāraḥ prapūrṇaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
2.3.d:
जीविते मम नाथे हि पार्वत्या प्रियया सह ।
सुविहारः प्रपूर्णश्च भविष्यति न संशयः ॥
2.3.m: Indeed, when my lord is restored to life, along with your beloved Pārvatī / your delightful dalliance will be complete, of this there is no doubt.

2.3.s:
sarvaṃ kartuṃ samartho'si yatastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ |
kiṃ bahūktyātra sarveśa jīvayāśu patiṃ mama ||
2.3.d:
सर्वं कर्तुं समर्थोऽसि यतस्त्वं परमेश्वरः ।
किं बहूक्त्यात्र सर्वेश जीवयाशु पतिं मम ॥
2.3.m: You are capable of doing everything, since you are Parameśvara. / What is the use of many words here, O lord of all? Revive my husband quickly!

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tadityuktvā kāmabhasma dadau sagranthibandhanam |
rudoda purataḥ śambhornātha nāthetyudīrya ca ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
तदित्युक्त्वा कामभस्म ददौ सग्रन्थिबन्धनम् ।
रुदोद पुरतः शम्भोर्नाथ नाथेत्युदीर्य च ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, she presented the ashes of Kāma tied in a bundle, / and wept before Śambhu, crying out, "O lord, O lord!"

2.3.s:
ratirodanamākarṇya sarasvatyādayaḥ striyaḥ |
ruruduḥ sakalā devyaḥ procurdīnataraṃ vacaḥ ||
devya ūcuḥ |
bhaktavatsalanāmā tvaṃ dīnabandhurdayānidhiḥ ||
2.3.d:
रतिरोदनमाकर्ण्य सरस्वत्यादयः स्त्रियः ।
रुरुदुः सकला देव्यः प्रोचुर्दीनतरं वचः ॥
देव्य ऊचुः ।
भक्तवत्सलनामा त्वं दीनबन्धुर्दयानिधिः ॥
2.3.m:
Hearing Rati's weeping, the women headed by Sarasvatī, / all the goddesses, wept and spoke words full of deep distress.

The goddesses said: / You are named affectionate toward devotees, the friend of the wretched, an ocean of mercy.

2.3.s: kāmaṃ jīvaya sotsāhāṃ ratiṃ kuru namo'stu te ||
2.3.d: कामं जीवय सोत्साहां रतिं कुरु नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
2.3.m: Revive Kāma, make Rati enthusiastic! Homage to you!

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ |
kṛpādṛṣṭiṃ cakārāśu karuṇāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नोऽभून्महेश्वरः ।
कृपादृष्टिं चकाराशु करुणासागरः प्रभुः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing those words of theirs, Maheśvara was pleased; / the lord, an ocean of compassion, quickly cast a merciful glance.

2.3.s:
sudhādṛṣṭyā śūlabhṛto bhasmato nirgataḥ smaraḥ |
tadrūpaveṣacihnātmā sundaro'dbhutamūrtimān ||
2.3.d:
सुधादृष्ट्या शूलभृतो भस्मतो निर्गतः स्मरः ।
तद्रूपवेषचिह्नात्मा सुन्दरोऽद्भुतमूर्तिमान् ॥
2.3.m: By the nectarous glance of the trident-bearer, Smara emerged from the ashes, / endowed with his own form, dress, and marks, handsome, having a wonderful figure.

2.3.s:
tadrūpaśca tadākāraṃ sasmitaṃ sadhanuśaram |
dṛṣṭvā patiṃ ratistaṃ ca praṇanāma maheśvaram ||
2.3.d:
तद्रूपश्च तदाकारं सस्मितं सधनुशरम् ।
दृष्ट्वा पतिं रतिस्तं च प्रणनाम महेश्वरम् ॥
2.3.m: Seeing her husband with that form, that shape, smiling, and equipped with bow and arrow, / Rati bowed down to him and to Maheśvara.

2.3.s:
kṛtārthābhūcchivaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ |
prāṇanāthapradaṃ patyā jīvitena punaḥ punaḥ ||
2.3.d:
कृतार्थाभूच्छिवं देवं तुष्टाव च कृताञ्जलिः ।
प्राणनाथप्रदं पत्या जीवितेन पुनः पुनः ॥
2.3.m: Her purpose fulfilled, with joined palms she praised god Śiva, / the giver of the lord of her life, along with her revived husband, again and again.

2.3.s:
kāmasya stutimākarṇya sanārīkasya śaṅkaraḥ |
prasanno'bhavadatyantamuvāca karuṇārdradhīḥ ||
2.3.d:
कामस्य स्तुतिमाकर्ण्य सनारीकस्य शङ्करः ।
प्रसन्नोऽभवदत्यन्तमुवाच करुणार्द्रधीः ॥
2.3.m: Hearing the praise of Kāma accompanied by his wife, Śaṅkara / became exceedingly pleased and, his mind softened by compassion, spoke:

2.3.s:
śaṅkara uvāca |
prasanno'haṃ tava stutyā sanārīkasya cittaja |
svayambhava varaṃ brūhi vāñchitaṃ tad dadāmi te ||
2.3.d:
शङ्कर उवाच ।
प्रसन्नोऽहं तव स्तुत्या सनारीकस्य चित्तज ।
स्वयम्भव वरं ब्रूहि वाञ्छितं तद् ददामि ते ॥
2.3.m: Śaṅkara said: / I am pleased by your praise together with your wife, O mind-born one! / O self-born one, choose a boon that you desire; I shall grant it to you.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
iti śambhuvacaḥ śrutvā mahānandaḥ smarastataḥ |
uvāca sāñjalirnamro gadgadākṣarayā girā ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इति शम्भुवचः श्रुत्वा महानन्दः स्मरस्ततः ।
उवाच साञ्जलिर्नम्रो गद्गदाक्षरया गिरा ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing these words of Śambhu, Smara, filled with great joy, / humble with joined palms, then spoke in a faltering voice:

2.3.s:
kāma uvāca |
devadeva mahādeva karuṇāsāgara prabho |
yadi prasannaḥ sarveśa mamānandakaro bhava ||
2.3.d:
काम उवाच ।
देवदेव महादेव करुणासागर प्रभो ।
यदि प्रसन्नः सर्वेश ममानन्दकरो भव ॥
2.3.m: Kāma said: / O god of gods, O Mahādeva, O lord who are an ocean of compassion! / If you are pleased, O lord of all, be the cause of my joy.

2.3.s:
kṣamasva me'parādhaṃ hi yatkṛtaśca purā prabho |
svajaneṣu parāṃ prītiṃ bhaktiṃ dehi svapādayoḥ ||
2.3.d:
क्षमस्व मेऽपराधं हि यत्कृतश्च पुरा प्रभो ।
स्वजनेषु परां प्रीतिं भक्तिं देहि स्वपादयोः ॥
2.3.m: Forgive my offense indeed, which was committed formerly, O lord! / Grant supreme love toward your people and devotion to your feet!

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityākarṇya smaravacaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
omityuktvābravīttaṃ vai vihasankaruṇānidhiḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्याकर्ण्य स्मरवचः प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः ।
ओमित्युक्त्वाब्रवीत्तं वै विहसन्करुणानिधिः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing the words of Smara, Parameśvara was pleased; / saying "Om," that ocean of compassion indeed spoke to him smilingly:

2.3.s:
īśvara uvāca |
he kāmāhaṃ prasanno'smi bhayaṃ tyaja mahāmate |
gaccha viṣṇusamīpaṃ ca bahiḥsthāne sthito bhava ||
2.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच ।
हे कामाहं प्रसन्नोऽस्मि भयं त्यज महामते ।
गच्छ विष्णुसमीपं च बहिःस्थाने स्थितो भव ॥
2.3.m: The Lord said: / O Kāma, I am pleased; abandon fear, O noble-minded one! / Go near Viṣṇu and remain stationed in an outside place.

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
tacchrutvā śirasā natvā parikramya stuvanvibhum |
bahirgatvā harindevān praṇamya samupāsta saḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
तच्छ्रुत्वा शिरसा नत्वा परिक्रम्य स्तुवन्विभुम् ।
बहिर्गत्वा हरिन्देवान् प्रणम्य समुपास्त सः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing that, bowing with his head, circumambulating, and praising the omnipresent lord, / he went outside, bowed down to Hari and the gods, and attended upon them.

2.3.s:
kāmaṃ sambhāṣya devāśca dadustasmai śubhāśiṣam |
viṣṇvādayaḥ prasannāste procuḥ smṛtvā śivaṃ hṛdi ||
2.3.d:
कामं सम्भाष्य देवाश्च ददुस्तस्मै शुभाशिषम् ।
विष्ण्वादयः प्रसन्नास्ते प्रोचुः स्मृत्वा शिवं हृदि ॥
2.3.m: Speaking to Kāma, the gods gave him auspicious blessings; / Viṣṇu and the others, delighted, remembering Śiva in their hearts, spoke:

2.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ |
dhanyastvaṃ smara sandagdhaḥ śivenānugrahīkṛtaḥ |
jīvayāmāsa sattvāṃśakṛpādṛṣṭyākhileśvaraḥ ||
2.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः ।
धन्यस्त्वं स्मर सन्दग्धः शिवेनानुग्रहीकृतः ।
जीवयामास सत्त्वांशकृपादृष्ट्याखिलेश्वरः ॥
2.3.m: The gods said: / Fortunate are you, O Smara, who, though burnt, have been favored by Śiva! / With a glance of compassion, the lord of all revived an essence of your being.

2.3.s:
sukhaduḥkhado na cānyo'sti yataḥ svakṛtabhuk pumān |
kāle rakṣā vivāhaśca niṣekaḥ kena vāryate ||
2.3.d:
सुखदुःखदो न चान्योऽस्ति यतः स्वकृतभुक् पुमान् ।
काले रक्षा विवाहश्च निषेकः केन वार्यते ॥
2.3.m: There is no other giver of happiness and sorrow, since a person reaps what he himself has done. / In time, protection, marriage, and impregnation—by whom can they be averted?

2.3.s:
brahmovāca |
ityuktvā te ca sammānya taṃ sukhenāmarāstadā |
santasthustatra viṣṇvādyāḥ sarve labdhamanorathāḥ ||
2.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ।
इत्युक्त्वा ते च सम्मान्य तं सुखेनामरास्तदा ।
सन्तस्थुस्तत्र विष्ण्वाद्याः सर्वे लब्धमनोरथाः ॥
2.3.m: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus and honored him with joy at that time, those immortals, / all Viṣṇu and the others, having obtained their desires, remained there.

2.3.s:
so'pi pramuditastatra samuvāsa śivājñayā |
jayaśabdo namaḥ śabdaḥ sādhuśabdo babhūva ha ||
2.3.d:
सोऽपि प्रमुदितस्तत्र समुवास शिवाज्ञया ।
जयशब्दो नमः शब्दः साधुशब्दो बभूव ह ॥
2.3.m: He too, delighted, dwelt there by the command of Śiva. / The sound of "Victory!", the sound of "Homage!", and the sound of "Well done!" arose.
